estimates.quote: Although it is only known from fragmentary remains, Argentinosaurus was one of the largest known land animals of all time, measuring 30 - 35 m long and weighing 65 - 80 t.

estimates.statement: A volumetric reconstruction displayed at the Carmen Funes Municipal Museum depicts the animal as 39.7 meters long, 7.3 meters high at the shoulders, and weighing 83.2 tons.
estimates.quote: Una reconstrucción de su esqueleto, montado y expuesto en el Museo municipal Carmen Funes, muestra al coloso titanosaurio con 39,7 metros de longitud, una altura de 7,3 metros hasta la zona de los hombros y una masa corporal de 83,2 toneladas, a partir de una estimación volumétrica.

estimates.statement: A later publication in Current Science proposed a maximum estimate of 45 meters in length and 100 tons in weight.
estimates.quote: Unos años más tarde, en una publicación de la revista Current Science, se le apunta con un estimado, máximo y liberal, de 45 metros y 100 toneladas de peso.

estimates.statement: An early reconstruction by Gregory S. Paul estimated Argentinosaurus to be between 30 and 35 meters long and weigh between 80 and 100 tons.
estimates.quote: Una temprana reconstrucción de Gregory S. Paul estimó que Argentinosaurus midió entre 30 y 35 metros de longitud y que pesó de 80 a 100 toneladas.

estimates.statement: Aristonectes measured more than 10 meters in length.
estimates.quote: Measuring more than 10 m long, Aristonectes is a notably imposing plesiosaur

estimates.statement: A referred specimen of Aristonectes from the López de Bertodano Formation in Antarctica (MLP 89-III-3-1) is estimated to be between 11 and 11.9 meters long and weigh between 10.7 and 13.5 metric tons.
estimates.quote: A referred specimen of Aristonectes discovered in the López de Bertodano Formation in Antarctica, cataloged as MLP 89-III-3-1, is considered to be one of the largest and heaviest plesiosaurs identified to date, having an estimated size between 11 - 11.9 m long and a body mass of 10.7 - 13.5 MT.

estimates.statement: Aristosuchus is estimated to have been about 2 meters long and weighed approximately 30 kilograms.
estimates.quote: It is thought to have been about 2 m in length, and is estimated to have weighed about 30 kg

estimates.statement: Armadillosuchus was a large and robust sphagesaurid crocodylomorph reaching a total length of about 2 meters.
estimates.quote: Armadillosuchus was among the larger and more robust sphagesaurids, with a total length of approximately 2 m.

estimates.statement: Specimen PMO 222.655 was estimated to be between 3.8 and 4.3 meters long.
estimates.quote: The partially preserved specimen PMO 222.655 has been estimated at 3.8 - 4.3 m based on comparisons to the contemporary ophthalmosaurid Undorosaurus.

estimates.statement: All species of Arthropterygius measured between 3 and 5 meters in length.
estimates.quote: Arthropterygius appears to have been a relatively large ichthyosaur, with all species measuring between 3 - 5 m long.

estimates.statement: Based on largely complete skeletons, Asiatosuchus may have grown up to 4 meters long.
estimates.quote: Based on largely complete skeletons of "A." germanicus and "A." depressifrons, Asiatosuchus may have grown up to 4 m long.

estimates.statement: Based on mostly complete skeletons of the dubious "A." germanicus and "A." depressifrons, Asiatosuchus may have reached 4 meters in length.
estimates.quote: Basándose en los esqueletos mayoritariamente completos de los dudosos "A." germanicus y "A." depressifrons, Asiatosuchus pudo haber alcanzado los 4 metros de longitud

estimates.statement: A. germanicus is estimated to have reached a length of 6.5 meters (21.5 feet).
estimates.quote: A.germanicus is estimated at 6.5 meters (21.5 ft) in length.

estimates.statement: Asilisaurus specimens are estimated to be 1 to 3 meters long, 0.5 to 1 meter high at the hip, and weigh 10 to 30 kilograms.
estimates.quote: Asilisaurus specimens have been estimated to measure from 1 to 3 m long and 0.5 to 1 m high at the hip, and may have weighed 10 to 30 kg.

estimates.statement: Atrociraptor is estimated to have been 1.8 to 2 meters long and weighed 15 kg.
estimates.quote: Estimated to have measured about 1.8 - 2 m in length and weighed 15 kg

estimates.statement: Atrociraptor was a small dromaeosaurid dinosaur estimated to be 1.8 to 2 meters long and weigh 15 kilograms.
estimates.quote: Atrociraptor was a relatively small dromaeosaurid, comparable to Velociraptor in size, and is estimated to have measured about 1.8 - 2 m in length and weighed 15 kg.

estimates.statement: Atychodracon is a medium-sized carnivorous plesiosaur, known from several individuals about 5 meters in total body length, with skulls measuring around 80 cm.
estimates.quote: Atychodracon es un plesiosaurio carnívoro de tamaño mediano, conocido por varios individuos de unos 5 metros de longitud total del cuerpo, con cráneos que miden alrededor de 80 cm.

estimates.statement: The holotype BRSMG Cb 2335 represented a complete articulated skeleton including the skull and lower jaw that measured 4.960 meters in total body length.
estimates.quote: BRSMG Cb 2335 representó un esqueleto completo y articulado que incluía el cráneo y la mandíbula inferior que medía 4.960 metros de longitud corporal total

estimates.statement: Atychodracon was a medium-sized carnivorous plesiosaur reaching lengths of 5 to 5.29 meters.
estimates.quote: Atychodracon is a medium size carnivorous plesiosaurian, known from several individuals of about 5 - 5.29 m in total body length.

estimates.statement: The original holotype skeleton was complete and articulated, measuring 4.960 meters in total length.
estimates.quote: BRSMG Cb 2335 represented a complete and articulated skeleton including the skull and lower jaw measuring 4.960 meters in total body length

estimates.statement: Willis estimated the length of Australosuchus to be around 3 meters.
estimates.quote: Australosuchus was a medium-sized crocodilian, with Willis suggesting an estimated length of around 3 m.

estimates.statement: Australovenator was approximately 6 meters long and weighed between 310 and 500 kilograms.
estimates.quote: Australovenator was around 6 m long and weighed 310-500 kg.

estimates.statement: Gregory S. Paul estimated Australovenator to be 6 meters long and weigh 500 kilograms in 2016.
estimates.quote: In 2016, American paleontologist Gregory S. Paul placed Australovenator at 6 m long and weighed 500 kg.

estimates.statement: Scott Hocknull estimated Australovenator stood 2 meters high at the hip and was 6 meters long.
estimates.quote: Según las declaraciones del Dr. Scott Hocknull a la prensa, este dinosaurio llegaría a medir 2m de alto desde la cadera y 6m de largo.

estimates.statement: Austroraptor was a large, bipedal carnivore that measured between 5 and 6 meters in length and weighed between 300 and 520 kilograms.
estimates.quote: measuring around 5 - 6 m long and weighing up to 300 - 520 kg.

estimates.statement: Austroraptor was a medium-sized bipedal hunter that could grow up to 6.2 meters long and weigh 340 kilograms.
estimates.quote: Austroraptor era un dinosaurio cazador bípedo de proporciones medias, que podría crecer hasta 6.2 metros de largo y con 340 kilogramos de peso corporal.

estimates.statement: Avimimus was a small, bird-like dinosaur measuring approximately 1.5 meters (5 feet) in length.
estimates.quote: Avimimus was a small, bird-like dinosaur with a length of 1.5 m (5 ft).

estimates.statement: Avimimus was a small dinosaur standing 45 centimeters tall at the hip and measuring about 1.6 meters in length.
estimates.quote: Avimimus era un dinosaurio pequeño, de 45 centímetros de altura hasta la cadera y un largo de alrededor de 1,6 metros.

estimates.statement: Bagaceratops was one of the smallest ceratopsians, reaching lengths of 1 to 1.5 meters and weighing between 22.7 and 45 kilograms.
estimates.quote: Bagaceratops was among the smallest ceratopsians, growing up to 1 - 1.5 m in length, with a weight about 22.7 - 45 kg.

estimates.statement: Adult Bagaceratops reached lengths of about 1 to 1.5 meters and weighed between 22.7 and 45 kilograms.
estimates.quote: Bagaceratops was a small-sized protoceratopsid, reaching adult dimensions of about 1 - 1.5 m in length and 22.7 - 45 kg in body mass based on Maginostris.

estimates.statement: Bagaceratops measured approximately 1 meter in length and weighed an estimated 22 kilograms.
estimates.quote: Bagaceratops medía aproximadamente 1 metro de largo, presentando un peso estimado de unos 22 kilogramos.

estimates.statement: Bahariasaurus is estimated to have been 11 to 12 meters long and weighed around 4 tons.
estimates.quote: Bahariasaurus is among the largest known theropods, estimated at 11 - 12 m long and around 4 t in weight.

estimates.statement: Bahariasaurus was a large predator reaching 11 to 12 meters in length and weighing 2.5 tons.
estimates.quote: Era un predador de gran tamaño que alcanzó unos 11 a 12 metros de largo y peso 2,5 toneladas.

estimates.statement: Bahariasaurus is estimated to have been 11 to 12.2 meters long and weighed between 4 and 4.6 tons.
estimates.quote: Bahariasaurus was a notably large theropod. It may have approached the height and length of other large-bodied theropods such as Tyrannosaurus rex and the contemporaneous Carcharodontosaurus, being estimated as 11 - 12.2 m long and 4 - 4.6 t.

estimates.statement: Bajadasaurus is estimated to have reached 12 meters in length, 3 meters in height, and weighed 4 tons.
estimates.quote: El tamaño completo se ha estimado en 12 metros de largo y 3 de altura y 4 toneladas de peso

estimates.statement: Using Stratiotosuchus as a reference, Molnar and Mequita de Vasconcellos estimated a length of 6.3 m.
estimates.quote: In doing so, they arrived at a length estimate of 6.3 m.

estimates.statement: The total length of the animal is estimated at nearly 6 meters based on comparisons with more complete sebecosuchians like Stratiotosuchus, making it the largest known sebecid.
estimates.quote: La longitud total del animal se estima en casi 6 metros basándose en la comparación con sebecosuquios más completos como Stratiotosuchus, lo que lo convierte en el mayor sebécido conocido.

estimates.statement: Using American and saltwater crocodiles as references, they estimated a length of about 7.5 m.
estimates.quote: Using modern crocodilians, specifically the American and saltwater crocodiles, as reference points, they attained a larger estimate of about 7.5 m.

estimates.statement: A 2023 paper suggested that Barinasuchus was around 3–4 m in length.
estimates.quote: The 2023 paper describing Dentaneosuchus, for example, suggested that both it and Barinasuchus were somewhere around 3–4 m in length.

estimates.statement: Based on head-length ratios, they suggested a maximum body length of 10 m.
estimates.quote: Based on the variability of head-length-to-total-length ratios in modern taxa, they suggested that Barinasuchus may have attained a maximum body length of 10 m.

estimates.statement: Adult Barosaurus measured between 25 and 27 meters in length and weighed between 12 and 20 metric tons.
estimates.quote: Barosaurus was an enormous animal, with some adults measuring about 25 - 27 m in length and weighing about 12–20 metric tons (13–22 short tons).

estimates.statement: Adult Barosaurus measured about 25 to 27 meters in length and weighed between 12 and 20 metric tons.
estimates.quote: Barosaurus was an enormous animal, with some adults measuring about 25 - 27 m in length and weighing about 12–20 metric tons (13–22 short tons).

estimates.statement: The entire body of Barreirosuchus may have been around 4 meters long.
estimates.quote: The entire body may have been around 4 m

estimates.statement: B. darrowi reached 4 meters in length and dates to the Middle Miocene.
estimates.quote: It was roughly the same size as Baru wickeni, reaching 4 m in length, and much younger, dating to the Middle Miocene.

estimates.statement: A 1997 review estimated Baru adults reached a length of around 4 meters.
estimates.quote: Willis described the genus as being "moderately large" in his 1997 review of Australasian fossil crocodilians, providing an approximate length estimate of around 4 m

estimates.statement: Baru was a semiaquatic crocodile reaching nearly 4 meters in length.
estimates.quote: Era semiacuático, con cerca de 4 metros de longitud.

estimates.statement: The holotype specimen of Baryonyx was estimated to be between 7.5 and 10 meters long and weigh between 1.2 and 2 metric tons.
estimates.quote: The holotype specimen, which may not have been fully grown, was estimated to have been between 7.5 and 10 m long and to have weighed between 1.2 and 2 MT.

estimates.statement: Baryonyx is estimated to have been 7.5 to 10 meters long, 2.5 meters tall at the hip, and weighed between 1.2 and 2 metric tons.
estimates.quote: Baryonyx is estimated to have been between 7.5 and 10 m long, 2.5 m in hip height, and to have weighed between 1.2 and 2 MT

estimates.statement: Baryonyx was a large predator measuring about 9.75 meters in length, 2.55 meters in hip height, and weighing between 1.7 and 2.7 tons.
estimates.quote: Baryonyx era un predador de gran tamaño que midió unos 9.75 metros de longitud, 2.55 de altura a la cadera y entre 1.7 y 2.7 toneladas

estimates.statement: Researchers estimate Bashanosaurus may have been about 3 meters long based on comparisons with Huayangosaurus.
estimates.quote: Based on the proportions of Huayangosaurus, Dai et al. (2022) estimate that Bashanosaurus may have been about 3 m long.

estimates.statement: Bathornis species varied in size from those comparable to modern seriemas to animals reaching 2 meters in length.
estimates.quote: Its numerous species span a large diversity of body sizes, ranging from forms about as large as modern seriemas to 2 m animals.

estimates.statement: Beibeilong was estimated to be about 7.5 meters long and weigh between 1.5 and 2 metric tons.
estimates.quote: Beibeilong was a notably large caenagnathid and among the largest oviraptorosaurs, estimated at 7.5 m long (extrapolated from the large embryo and eggs) with a ponderous weight of about 1.5 - 2 MT, based on comparisons with the closely related Gigantoraptor.

estimates.statement: Beipiaosaurus were small therizinosaurs, reaching about 2.2 meters in length and weighing approximately 27 kilograms.
estimates.quote: They were relatively small-sized therizinosaurs, measuring 2.2 m long and weighing about 27 kg in contrast to the advanced and giant Segnosaurus or Therizinosaurus.

estimates.statement: The largest known specimen of Beipiaosaurus is estimated to be 2.2 meters long.
estimates.quote: Beipiaosaurus was a small therizinosaur, with the largest specimen having an estimated length of 2.2 m.

estimates.statement: Beipiaosaurus was approximately 2.2 meters long and 0.9 meters tall, making it the second largest known feathered dinosaur.
estimates.quote: Beipiaosaurus medía alrededor de 2,2 metros de largo y 0,9 de altura, por lo que se trata del segundo dinosaurio con plumas más grande conocido.

estimates.statement: In 2024, Gregory S. Paul estimated Beipiaosaurus' body length at 1.8 meters and its mass at around 50 kilograms.
estimates.quote: In 2024, Gregory S. Paul estimated Beipiaosaurus' body length at 1.8 m, and its body mass at around 50 kg.

estimates.statement: The largest known specimen of Besanosaurus is estimated to be about 8 meters long.
estimates.quote: Besanosaurus is a large ichthyosaur, with the largest known specimen estimated to measure about 8 m long

estimates.statement: The largest known specimen of Besanosaurus, PIMUZ T 4847, was estimated at 8 meters long, making it the largest known ichthyosaur in its environment.
estimates.quote: The specimen PIMUZ T 4847 was estimated by Bindellini and colleagues in 2021 to have a total length of 8 m, and is the largest known specimen of Besanosaurus, indicating that Besanosaurus is the largest known ichthyosaur in its environment

estimates.statement: Besanosaurus was a reptile about 6 meters long with a dolphin-like profile and a shape similar to the extinct Basilosaurus.
estimates.quote: Besanosaurus era un reptil de cerca de 6 metros de longitud y tenía un perfil similar al de los delfines y forma similar al extinto Basilosaurus

estimates.statement: The holotype specimen of Besanosaurus measured 5.065 meters in length.
estimates.quote: The holotype specimen measures 5.065 m long from its snout tip to tail tip

estimates.statement: Bicharracosaurus had an estimated length of 15 meters and a weight of 20 tonnes.
estimates.quote: Bicharracosaurus had an estimated length of 15 m and a weight of 20 t.

estimates.statement: Bonapartenykus is the largest known member of the Alvarezsauroidea clade, with an estimated length of 2.5 to 3.3 meters and a weight of 43 to 72 kilograms.
estimates.quote: It has an estimated length of 2.5 - 3.3 m and weight of 43 - 72 kg, making it the largest member of the clade Alvarezsauroidea.

estimates.statement: Borealopelta measured 5.5 meters long and weighed 1.3 metric tons.
estimates.quote: Borealopelta was a large dinosaur, measuring 5.5 m long and weighing 1.3 MT.

estimates.statement: The animal had an approximate length of 5.5 meters and a conservative mass estimate of around 1,300 kilograms.
estimates.quote: Con una longitud aproximada de 5,5 metros y una estimación conservadora de una masa de alrededor de 1.300 kilogramos

estimates.statement: Most species of Bothriolepis were small, benthic freshwater detritivores averaging about 30 cm in length.
estimates.quote: Most species of Bothriolepis were characterized as relatively small, benthic, freshwater detritivores (organisms that obtain nutrients by consuming decomposing plant/animal material), averaging around 30 cm in length.

estimates.statement: The head and trunk armor of B. africana ranged from 20 to 300 mm, corresponding to full body lengths between 52 and 780 mm.
estimates.quote: The head and trunk armour lengths ranged between 20 - 300 mm which translates, based on the proportions of two of the smallest individuals (in which tail impressions are preserved) into full body lengths varying between 52 - 780 mm.

estimates.statement: This pliosaur grew to a body length of nearly 10 meters.
estimates.quote: Este pliosaurio crecía hasta cerca de 10 metros de longitud corporal.

estimates.statement: The holotype specimen of Brachauchenius is estimated to have reached a maximum length of 5.3 meters and a body mass of 2.2 tons.
estimates.quote: the holotype specimen having a maximum length estimated at 5.3 m for a body mass estimated at 2.2 t.

estimates.statement: Brachiosaurus is estimated to have been 18 to 22 meters long, with a body mass between 28.3 and 46.9 metric tons.
estimates.quote: Brachiosaurus is estimated to have been between 18 and 22 m long; body mass estimates of the subadult holotype specimen range from 28.3 to 46.9 MT.

estimates.statement: Brachiosaurus has been estimated to reach lengths of 18 to 22 meters and heights of 9.4 to 13 meters.
estimates.quote: The length of Brachiosaurus has been estimated at 20–22 meters (66–72ft) and 18 m, and its height at 9.4 m and 12 - 13 m.

estimates.statement: The estimated length of Brachiosaurus is 26 meters.
estimates.quote: La longitud del Brachiosaurus se ha estimado en 26 metros

estimates.statement: Brachiosaurus is regarded as a high browser capable of reaching vegetation up to 9 meters off the ground.
estimates.quote: It is regarded as a high browser, possibly cropping or nipping vegetation as high as 9 m off the ground.

estimates.statement: Adult Brachylophosaurus reached a length of at least 9 meters.
estimates.quote: Brachylophosaurus was a typical hadrosaur which reached an adult length of at least 9 m.

estimates.statement: In 2010, Gregory S. Paul estimated the maximum length of Brachylophosaurus at 11 meters and its weight at 7 metric tons.
estimates.quote: In 2010, Gregory S. Paul estimated maximum length at 11 m resulting in weight of 7 MT.

estimates.statement: Brancasaurus was modest in size compared to many other plesiosaurs, reaching no more than 3.5 meters in length.
estimates.quote: Su longitud es más modesta comparada con la de muchos otros plesiosaurios (por ejemplo, Elasmosaurus), y no sobrepasaba los 3,5 metros.

estimates.statement: A 2024 estimate by Gregory S. Paul suggests Brighstoneus was approximately 6 meters long and weighed about 1 ton.
estimates.quote: In 2024, Gregory S. Paul estimated that Brighstoneus was probably 6 m in length, and provided a body mass estimate of about 1 t.

estimates.statement: The largest species, B. excelsus, reached lengths of 21 to 23 meters and weighed 15 to 20 tonnes, while the smaller B. parvus grew up to 19 meters long.
estimates.quote: Several size estimates have been made, with the largest species B. excelsus reaching up to 21 - 23 m from head to tail and weighing in at 15 - 20 t, whereas the smaller B. parvus only got up to 19 m long.

estimates.statement: The largest species, B. excelsus, grew up to 23 meters long and weighed up to 20 tons, while other species reached 19 meters and 14 tons.
estimates.quote: The largest species, B. excelsus, measured up to 21 - 23 m long from head to tail and weighed up to 15 - 20 t; other species were smaller, measuring 19 m long and weighing 14 MT.

estimates.statement: Brontosaurus yahnahpin grew to a maximum length of 21 meters.
estimates.quote: It grew up to 21 m long.

estimates.statement: B. yahnahpin reached a length of 21 meters.
estimates.quote: Llegaba a medir 21 metros de largo.

estimates.statement: The largest known specimens of B. excelsus could reach a length of 22 meters and weigh up to 15 tonnes.
estimates.quote: The largest of these specimens is estimated to have weighed up to 15 tonnes and measured up to 22 m long from head to tail.

estimates.statement: The largest specimens of B. excelsus are estimated to have weighed over 15 tons and measured over 22 meters in body length.
estimates.quote: Se estima que el mayor de estos especímenes habría pesado más de 15 toneladas y medía más de 22 metros de longitud corporal.

estimates.statement: Adult specimens of B. parvus are estimated to have weighed over 14 tons and measured over 22 meters in body length.
estimates.quote: Se estima que los especímenes adultos pesaban más de 14 toneladas y medían más de 22 metros de longitud corporal.

estimates.statement: Gregory S. Paul estimated in 2010 that Buitreraptor measured 1.5 meters in length and weighed three kilograms.
estimates.quote: In 2010, Gregory S. Paul estimated the length at 1.5 metres, the weight at three kilograms.

estimates.statement: Buitreraptor is estimated to have reached a length of 1.20 meters, a height of 40 centimeters, and a weight of 5 kilograms.
estimates.quote: Se calcula que llegó a medir 1.20 metros de largo, 40 centímetros de alto y a pesar 5 kilogramos.

estimates.statement: Adult Calamosaurus individuals are estimated to have been between 3 and 5 meters long.
estimates.quote: Se ha estimado que el tamaño de un individuo adulto pudo oscilar entre los 3 y 5 metros de largo

estimates.statement: The most common species, Camarasaurus lentus, reached a maximum length of about 15 meters.
estimates.quote: El tamaño máximo de la especie más común, C. lentus, era de unos 15 metros de longitud

estimates.statement: The largest species, Camarasaurus supremus, reached a maximum length of 23 meters and an estimated weight of 47 tons.
estimates.quote: La especie más grande, C. supremus, alcanzó una longitud máxima de 23 metros y un peso máximo estimado de 47 toneladas

estimates.statement: Specimens from Quarry 13 were smaller, reaching lengths of 6 meters and weighing between 785 and 874 kilograms.
estimates.quote: Pero los especímenes de la cantera 13 son más pequeños, llegando a medir 6 metros de longitud y pesando 785 a 874 kg de peso

estimates.statement: Camptosaurus typically reached 5 to 6 meters in length and weighed between 500 and 1000 kilograms.
estimates.quote: It is estimated that Camptosaurus typically reached 5 - 6 m long and weighed 500 - 1000 kg.

estimates.statement: The largest known fragments indicate that adult Camptosaurus could reach around 6.79 meters in length.
estimates.quote: The largest fragments from later strata indicate adult individuals around 6.79 m long.

estimates.statement: C. saharicus grew to about 12 meters in length and weighed between 5 and 7 metric tons, making it one of the largest known theropods.
estimates.quote: C. saharicus reached around 12 m in length and approximately 5 - 7 MT in body mass, and was therefore one of the largest theropod dinosaurs known.

estimates.statement: The neotype specimen of Carcharodontosaurus saharicus was estimated to be 12 to 12.5 meters long and weigh between 5 and 7 metric tons.
estimates.quote: The latter was estimated to be 12 - 12.5 m in length and approximately 5 - 7 MT in body mass.

estimates.statement: Estimates for Carcharodontosaurus saharicus range from 12 to 12.5 meters in length and 6 tons in weight.
estimates.quote: Las diferentes estimaciones de longitud y peso de la especie C. saharicus oscilan entre 12 a 12.5 metros de longitud y entre las 6 toneladas de peso.

estimates.statement: The largest known specimen is estimated to be between 12 and 12.8 meters long and weigh about 6.2 tons.
estimates.quote: se estima que su tamaño fue de entre 12 y 12,8 metros de longitud y su peso en unas 6,2 toneladas

estimates.statement: A 2007 study by François Therrien and Donald M. Henderson estimated Carcharodontosaurus at 13.3 meters long and 15.1 metric tons, surpassing both Tyrannosaurus and Giganotosaurus.
estimates.quote: In 2007, Canadian researcher François Therrien and American researcher Donald M. Henderson found that Giganotosaurus would have approached 13 m in length and 13.8 MT in weight, while Carcharodontosaurus would have approached 13.3 m in length and 15.1 MT in weight (surpassing both Tyrannosaurus and Giganotosaurus).

estimates.statement: Carcharodontosaurus iguidensis was smaller than C. saharicus, reaching only 10 meters in length and 4 metric tons in body mass.
estimates.quote: C. iguidensis was much smaller, only reaching 10 m in length and 4 MT in body mass.

estimates.statement: Gregory S. Paul estimated Carcharodontosaurus iguidensis measured 10 meters in length and weighed 4 tons.
estimates.quote: Gregory S. Paul estima que C. iguidensis medía 10 metros de largo y pesaba 4 toneladas.

estimates.statement: Gregory S. Paul estimates that C. iguidensis was 10 meters long and weighed 4 tons.
estimates.quote: Gregory S. Paul estima que C. iguidensis medía 10 metros de largo y pesaba 4 toneladas.

estimates.statement: Stromer originally estimated Carcharodontosaurus saharicus to be 8 to 9 meters long based on specimen SNSB-BSPG 1922 X 46, which is now known as Tameryraptor.
estimates.quote: Stromer hypothesized that C. saharicus was around the same size as the tyrannosaurid Gorgosaurus, which placed it at around 8 - 9 m long, based on his specimen SNSB-BSPG 1922 X 46 (now Tameryraptor).

estimates.statement: Cardabiodon individuals were born between 41 and 76 cm long and reached sexual maturity at five to seven years of age.
estimates.quote: At birth, Cardabiodon individuals measured between 41-76 cm in length and reached sexual maturity at around five to seven years of age

estimates.statement: An early Cardabiodontid individual from the Albian age was estimated to reach a length of 8 to 9 meters.
estimates.quote: that belonged to an individual that was estimated to measure 8-9 m in length.

estimates.statement: Carnotaurus was a lightly built, bipedal predator that measured between 7.5 and 8 meters in length and weighed between 1.3 and 2.1 metric tons.
estimates.quote: Carnotaurus was a lightly built, bipedal predator, measuring 7.5 to 8 m in length and weighing 1.3 - 2.1 MT.

estimates.statement: At 7.5 to 8 meters long, the known individual of Carnotaurus represents one of the largest abelisaurids.
estimates.quote: The only known individual was about 7.5 - 8 m in length, making Carnotaurus one of the largest abelisaurids.

estimates.statement: Cartorhynchus was a small animal measuring about 40 cm in length with a lizard-like body and short torso.
estimates.quote: Measuring about 40 cm long, Cartorhynchus was a small animal with a lizard-like body and a short torso

estimates.statement: Cartorhynchus could have measured 40 cm in length and weighed only 2 kilograms.
estimates.quote: Es más pequeño que los ictiopterigios, pudo haber medido 40 cm de longitud y pesado solamente 2 kilogramos.

estimates.statement: The two species of Caudipteryx reached lengths of up to one meter, heights of 0.7 meters, and weighed between 6 and 7 kilograms.
estimates.quote: En general, las 2 especies de Caudipterix llegaban a medir hasta un metro de longitud y 0,7 de altura y a pesar entre 6 y 7 kilogramos

estimates.statement: Caudipteryx was a small theropod measuring between 72.5 and 89 cm in length and weighing about 5 kg.
estimates.quote: Caudipteryx was a small theropod, measuring 72.5 - 89 cm long and weighing about 5 kg based on femur length.

estimates.statement: Cedarpelta is estimated to have been 7 meters long and weighed 5 tonnes.
estimates.quote: Cedarpelta has an estimated length of 7 metres (23 feet) and weight of 5 tonnes (11,023 lbs).

estimates.statement: Gregory S. Paul estimated the body length at 7 meters and the weight at 5 tonnes.
estimates.quote: Gregory S. Paul indicó una longitud corporal de 7 metros y un peso de 5 toneladas.

estimates.statement: Centrosaurus reached lengths of 5 to 5.5 meters and masses of 2 to 2.5 metric tons.
estimates.quote: Centrosaurus were large dinosaurs, although not as large as some of their relatives, reaching 5 - 5.5 m long and 2 - 2.5 MT in body mass situated atop stocky limbs.

estimates.statement: Centrosaurus had a massive body supported by robust legs and measured about 6 meters in length.
estimates.quote: Los cuerpos masivos de Centrosaurus fueron soportados por extremidades robustas, media unos 6 metros de largo

estimates.statement: The holotype specimen of C. lyelli was approximately 24.5 cm long in life.
estimates.quote: The holotype specimen of Cephalaspis lyelli would have been around 24.5 cm long in life.

estimates.statement: Ceratonykus is estimated to have been 75 cm long and weighed 760 g.
estimates.quote: Ceratonykus has an estimated length of 75 cm and weight of 760 g.

estimates.statement: In 2016, Gregory S. Paul estimated Ceratonykus to be 0.6 meters long and weigh 1 kg.
estimates.quote: In 2016, Gregory S. Paul gave Ceratonykus an estimated length of 0.6 m and weight of 1 kg.

estimates.statement: Specimen ML 352, discovered in Portugal in 2000, was estimated to be 6 m long and weigh 600 kg.
estimates.quote: Another specimen, ML 352, discovered in Portugal in 2000, was estimated at 6 m in length and 600 kg in weight.

estimates.statement: The holotype specimen USNM 4735 of Ceratosaurus nasicornis was estimated to be 5.3 m or 5.69 m long.
estimates.quote: Specimen USNM 4735, the first discovered skeleton and holotype of Ceratosaurus nasicornis, was an individual 5.3 m or 5.69 m long according to separate sources.

estimates.statement: The holotype specimen of Ceratosaurus corresponds to an individual approximately 5.3 meters long and 2 meters high.
estimates.quote: El espécimen holotipo de Ceratosaurus corresponde a un individuo de unos 5,3 metros de largo y 2 metros de alto

estimates.statement: The largest known species, C. dentisulcatus, was informally estimated by Madsen to be around 8.8 meters long.
estimates.quote: El más grande de estos, C. dentisuclatus, fue estimado informalmente por Madsen en alrededor de 8,8 metros de largo

estimates.statement: The original specimen is estimated to be between 5.3 m and 5.69 m in length.
estimates.quote: The original specimen is estimated to be 5.3 m or 5.69 m long

estimates.statement: Ceratosuchops is estimated to have measured around 8.5 meters in length based on skeletal reconstruction.
estimates.quote: Se estima que Ceratosuchops media alrededor 8.5 metros de largo según la reconstrucción esquelética en el artículo que lo describe

estimates.statement: Cetiosaurus is estimated to have reached a length of about 16 meters and a weight of roughly 11 tons.
estimates.quote: It is estimated to have been about 16 m long and to have weighed roughly 11 t.

estimates.statement: In 2010, Gregory S. Paul estimated the body length of Cetiosaurus at 16 meters and its mass at 11 tonnes.
estimates.quote: In 2010, Gregory S. Paul estimated the body length at 16 m and body mass at 11 t.

estimates.statement: In 2010, Gregory S. Paul estimated the body length at 16 meters and the weight at 11 tonnes.
estimates.quote: En 2010, Gregory S. Paul estimó la longitud del cuerpo a 16 metros, el peso en 11 toneladas

estimates.statement: The C. oxoniensis specimen displayed at Leicester Museum and Art Gallery is 15 meters long and consists of fourteen cervical, ten dorsal, five sacral, and about fifty caudal vertebrae.
estimates.quote: The specimen on display at Leicester Museum and Art Gallery is 15 m (49 ft) in length and has fourteen cervical vertebrae, ten dorsals, five sacrals and about fifty caudals.

estimates.statement: The incomplete fossil is 15 meters long and has been exhibited since 1985 at the New Walk Museum in Leicester.
estimates.quote: El fósil incompleto tiene 15 metros de largo y se ha exhibido desde 1985 en el Museo New Walk en Leicester.

estimates.statement: Cetiosaurus was a primitive long-necked quadrupedal herbivore that reached 18 meters in length.
estimates.quote: Cetiosaurus fue un primitivo herbívoro cuadrúpedo de cuello largo que alcanzó los 18 metros de largo

estimates.statement: Chaohusaurus was one of the smallest known ichthyosaurs, measuring between 70 and 180 centimeters in length.
estimates.quote: Era uno de los ictiosaurios conocidos más pequeños, midiendo entre 70 a 180 centímetros de largo.

estimates.statement: In 2010, G.S. Paul estimated the length of Chasmosaurus belli at 4.8 meters and its weight at two tonnes.
estimates.quote: In 2010 G.S. Paul estimated the length of C. belli at 4.8 metres, its weight at two tonnes.

estimates.statement: In 2010, G.S. Paul estimated C. belli was 4.8 meters long and weighed 2 tons, while C. russelli was estimated at 4.3 meters long and 1.5 tons.
estimates.quote: En 2010 GS Paul estimó la longitud de C. belli en 4,8 metros, su peso en 2 toneladas; C. russelli tendría 4,3 metros de largo y pesaba 1.5 toneladas.

estimates.statement: Chenanisaurus was estimated to be 7 to 8 meters long, making it one of the largest known abelisaurids.
estimates.quote: Its length is estimated to be around 7 - 8 m, making it among the largest known abelisaurids.

estimates.statement: Based on measurements of the holotype dentary, Chenanisaurus is a large abelisaurid measuring between 7 and 8 meters in length.
estimates.quote: Chenanisaurus es un gran abelisáurido, que mide entre 7 a 8 metros, basado en mediciones del holotipo dentario

estimates.statement: Chilantaisaurus reached a length of approximately 11 meters and weighed between 2.5 and 4 metric tons.
estimates.quote: Chilantaisaurus was around 11 m in length and weighed 2.5 - 4 MT.

estimates.statement: Chilantaisaurus was a large theropod dinosaur that measured 11 meters in length and weighed between 2.5 and 4 metric tons.
estimates.quote: Chilantaisaurus was a large theropod, measuring 11 m long and weighing 2.5 - 4 MT.

estimates.statement: Chilantaisaurus was a large theropod measuring 11 to 13 meters in length and weighing an estimated 2.5 to 4 metric tons.
estimates.quote: Chilantaisaurus era un gran terópodo, tenía 11 metros a 13 metros de largo con un peso estimado de entre 2.5 toneladas y 4 toneladas métricas.

estimates.statement: The type and paratype specimens were approximately 2 to 2.3 meters in length.
estimates.quote: Los especímenes de tipo y paratipo tenían aproximadamente 2 a 2,3 metros de longitud.

estimates.statement: Holtz (2012) estimated Chindesaurus was about 2 meters long and weighed between 23 and 45 kilograms.
estimates.quote: Holtz (2012) estimated that Chindesaurus had a length of about 2 meters (6.6) feet and a weight equivalent to that of a wolf (23–45 kg, or about 50-100 pounds).

estimates.statement: Long and Murry estimated Chindesaurus had a stout body, long legs, and a length of 3 to 4 meters.
estimates.quote: Long & Murry reconstructed Chindesaurus with a stout body, long legs, a fairly long neck, and a total estimated length of 3 to 4 m.

estimates.statement: A 2016 study estimated Chirostenotes to be 2.5 meters long and weigh 100 kilograms.
estimates.quote: In 2016 Paul estimated its length at 2.5 m and its weight at 100 kg (220 lbs)

estimates.statement: Chirostenotes measured approximately 2.85 meters in length, 90 centimeters high at the hip, and weighed an estimated 50 kilograms.
estimates.quote: Chirostenotes medía aproximadamente 2,85 metros de largo y 90 centímetros de alto hasta la cadera, con un peso estimado de 50 kilogramos

estimates.statement: Chuanqilong was approximately 4.5 meters long and weighed an estimated 450 kilograms.
estimates.quote: Media cerca de 4,5 metros de largo y su peso se estima en unos 450 kilogramos.

estimates.statement: The original description estimated Chuanqilong's length at 4.5 meters (14.8 feet).
estimates.quote: Han et al. (2014) gave Chuanqilong an estimated length of 4.5 metres (14.8 feet)

estimates.statement: Citipati was among the largest oviraptorids, with an estimated length of 2.5 to 2.9 meters and a weight of 75 to 110 kilograms.
estimates.quote: Citipati was among the largest oviraptorids; measuring an estimated 2.5 - 2.9 m in length and weighing 75 - 110 kg.

estimates.statement: Citipati was a large-bodied oviraptorid estimated to be 2.5 to 2.9 meters long and weigh between 75 and 110 kilograms.
estimates.quote: Citipati was a large-bodied oviraptorid, with the largest individuals being emu-sized animals; it has been estimated at 2.5 - 2.9 m in length with a weight between 75 - 110 kg

estimates.statement: The largest Citipati were about the size of emus, reaching nearly 3 meters in length.
estimates.quote: Los más grandes citipati eran animales del tamaño de emúes, con cerca de 3 metros de largo

estimates.statement: Coelophysis was a lightly built dinosaur that measured up to 3 meters in length and stood more than one meter tall at the hips.
estimates.quote: This lightly built dinosaur measured up to 3 m long and was more than a meter tall at the hips.

estimates.statement: Coelophysis likely reached sexual maturity between its second and third year of life and attained a full length of just over 10 feet by its eighth year.
estimates.quote: Coelophysis likely reached sexual maturity between the second and third year of life and reached its full size, just above 10 feet in length, by its eighth year.

estimates.statement: Coelophysis measured between 2.5 and 3 meters in length and reached about one meter in height at the hips.
estimates.quote: llegaba a medir de 2,5 a 3 metros de longitud, alcanzaba el metro de altura a la cadera

estimates.statement: Coelurus weighed between 13 and 20 kilograms, measured about 2.4 meters long, and stood 0.7 meters tall at the hip.
estimates.quote: Its weight has been estimated at around 13 to 20 kg, with a length of about 2.4 meters (7.9 ft) and a hip height of 0.7 meters (2.3 ft).

estimates.statement: Coelurus is estimated to have weighed between 13 and 20 kilograms, measured 2.4 meters in length, and stood 0.7 meters tall at the hip.
estimates.quote: su peso se ha estimado entre 13 a 20 kilogramos, con un largo de 2,4 metros y una altura a la cadera de 0,7 metros

estimates.statement: The German specimen of Compsognathus was estimated to be between 70 and 75 centimeters tall and 89 centimeters long, while the French specimen was estimated to be between 1.25 and 1.4 meters long.
estimates.quote: The German specimen was estimated to be 70–75 cm and 89 cm in length by separate authors, while the larger French specimen was estimated at 1.25 m and 1.4 m in length.

estimates.statement: Two nearly complete skeletons are known, one in Germany measuring 85 cm and another in France measuring 155 cm.
estimates.quote: A Compsognathus se le conocen dos esqueletos casi completos, uno en Alemania que es de 85 cm de largo, y otro en Francia, de 155 cm

estimates.statement: Confuciusornis was roughly the size of a modern crow, measuring about 50 cm in total length with a wingspan of up to 70 cm.
estimates.quote: Confuciusornis was about the size of a modern crow, with a total length of 50 cm and a wingspan of up to 70 cm.

estimates.statement: The type specimen of Corythoraptor reached a length of 1.6 meters.
estimates.quote: The type specimen reached 1.6 m in length.

estimates.statement: Corythoraptor reached about 1.6 meters in length at the time of its death, which is considered medium-sized for an oviraptorid.
estimates.quote: At this point in its development, Corythoraptor reached about 1.6 m in length, which is medium-sized for an oviraptorid.

estimates.statement: Benson et al. (2012) estimated the average length of Corythosaurus to be 9 meters.
estimates.quote: Benson et al. (2012) estimated that Corythosaurus has an average length of 9 m.

estimates.statement: Corythosaurus had an estimated length of 9 meters and a skull with crest height of 70.8 centimeters.
estimates.quote: Corythosaurus tiene una longitud estimada de 9 metros, y tiene un cráneo, incluida la cresta, que mide 70,8 centímetros de alto.

estimates.statement: Researchers estimated in 2012 that Corythosaurus had an average length of 9 meters.
estimates.quote: Benson et al. en 2012 estimaron que Corythosaurus tiene una longitud promedio de 9 metros.

estimates.statement: Corythosaurus was estimated to be 7.7 to 9 meters long with a skull and crest 70.8 cm tall.
estimates.quote: Corythosaurus has an estimated length of 7.7 - 9 m and has a skull, including the crest, that is 70.8 cm tall.

estimates.statement: The total length of the Corythosaurus specimen AMNH 5240 was 8.1 meters with a weight of 3.0785 tonnes.
estimates.quote: La longitud total del espécimen de Corythosaurus AMNH 5240 fue de 8.1 metros, con un peso de 3,0785 toneladas.

estimates.statement: Gregory S. Paul (2016) estimated C. casuarius reached 8 meters long and 2.8 metric tons, while C. intermedius reached 7.7 meters long and 2.5 metric tons.
estimates.quote: In 2016, Gregory S. Paul estimated that C. casuarius reached 8 m long and 2.8 MT in weight and that C. intermedius reached 7.7 m in length and 2.5 MT in weight.

estimates.statement: This specimen represents an individual that was 6.1 meters long.
estimates.quote: Este espécimen representa a un individuo de 6,1 metros de largo

estimates.statement: A Cretoxyrhina skeleton reported to be 20 feet long contained stomach contents of a Xiphactinus and about 150 visible teeth.
estimates.quote: This skeleton was reported to measure 20 ft in length and consists of a partial vertebral column with skeletal remains of a Xiphactinus as stomach contents and partial jaws with about 150 teeth visible.

estimates.statement: C. mantelli grew up to 7 meters long and rivaled the size of the modern great white shark, Carcharodon carcharias.
estimates.quote: C. mantelli crecía hasta los 7 metros de largo y rivalizaba en tamaño con el actual gran tiburón blanco, Carcharodon carcharias

estimates.statement: The shark grew up to 8 meters long and weighed approximately 5000 kilograms.
estimates.quote: Measuring up to 8 m in length and weighing around 5000 kg, Cretoxyrhina was one of the largest sharks of its time.

estimates.statement: Other species like C. denticulata and C. vraconensis reached a maximum adult length of up to 4 meters.
estimates.quote: Other species were estimated to have been significantly smaller. C. denticulata and C. vraconensis reached a total body length of up to 4 m as an adult.

estimates.statement: In 2013, Mikael Siverson and colleagues noted that offshore Cretoxyrhina mantelli during the Turonian or early Coniacian were usually larger than those in the Western Interior Seaway, with some reaching lengths up to 8 meters, possibly 9 meters.
estimates.quote: In 2013, Mikael Siverson and colleagues noted that during the Turonian or early Coniacian, Cretoxyrhina individuals living offshore were usually larger than those inhabiting the Western Interior Seaway, with some of the offshore C. mantelli fossils like one of the syntypes yielding total lengths of up to 8 m, possibly 9 m.

estimates.statement: Cricosaurus was a relatively small reptile, with species like C. suevicus reaching 2 meters and C. araucanensis reaching 3.2 meters in total body length.
estimates.quote: It was a relatively small reptile, with C. suevicus and C. araucanensis measuring 2 m and 3.2 m in total body length, respectively.

estimates.statement: The largest specimens of Crocodylus lucivenator reached lengths of 4 to 5 meters and weights of 300 to 600 kilograms.
estimates.quote: The largest specimens of Crocodylus lucivenator reached a length between 4-5 m and likely reached a weight between 300-600 kg.

estimates.statement: William R. Hammer and William J. Hickerson estimated Cryolophosaurus length at 6 to 7 meters in 1999.
estimates.quote: Se calculó que Cryolophosaurus tenía una longitud de 6 a 7metros por William R. Hammer y William J. Hickerson en 1999.

estimates.statement: A 2007 study by Nathan Smith et al. revised the length estimate to 6.5 meters.
estimates.quote: Un estudio de 2007 de Nathan Smith et al. revisó la longitud a 6,5metros.

estimates.statement: Larger adult Cryolophosaurus are estimated to have reached a length of 8 meters.
estimates.quote: The larger adults are estimated at 8 m (26 ft) in length.

estimates.statement: This marine reptile had two pairs of flippers and an eel-like tail, lacking a dorsal fin, with a length of approximately 6 to 10 meters.
estimates.quote: Este reptil marino tenía 2 pares de aletas y una cola parecida a la de las anguilas y debido a ser uno de los primeros reptiles marinos ictiosauros, era el ictiosaurio menos parecido a los peces ya que este no poseía la aleta dorsal; con una longitud aproximada de 6 a 10 metros.

estimates.statement: The smallest species of Cymbospondylus reached a length of approximately 4 to 5 meters.
estimates.quote: The different species of Cymbospondylus vary greatly in size, with the smallest reaching around 4 to 5 m in length.

estimates.statement: C. youngorum is estimated to reach 17.65 meters in length and weigh 44.7 metric tons, making it one of the largest ichthyosaurs known.
estimates.quote: The holotype specimen of C. youngorum having a skull measuring almost 2 m long and its humerus being the second largest bone of this type recorded in an ichthyosaur, the maximum size of the animal is therefore estimated at 17.65 m for a weight of 44.7 MT.

estimates.statement: Dacentrurus is one of the largest known stegosaurs, reaching lengths of 8 to 9 meters and weights of up to 7.4 metric tons.
estimates.quote: Dacentrurus is among the largest known stegosaurs, measuring around 8 - 9 m long and weighing up to 5 - 7.4 MT.

estimates.statement: Dacentrurus was one of the largest stegosaurs, with specimens reaching 8 to 9 meters in length, 1.8 meters in hip height, and 5 to 7.4 metric tons in body mass.
estimates.quote: Dacentrurus was one of the largest genera of stegosaurs along with Stegosaurus, with some specimens having been estimated to reach 8 - 9 m in length, 1.8 m in hip height and 5 - 7.4 MT in body mass.

estimates.statement: Some specimens of Dacentrurus are estimated to reach lengths of 7 to 8 meters and weigh up to 5 tonnes.
estimates.quote: Se ha estimado que algunos especímenes alcanzan longitudes de 7-8 metros y que pesan hasta 5 toneladas.

estimates.statement: Sues estimated Daemonosaurus to be around 1.5 meters long based on related theropod proportions.
estimates.quote: Based on the proportions of related theropods, Daemonosaurus is estimated to have been around 1.5 m (5 feet) long according to Sues.

estimates.statement: Holtz estimated Daemonosaurus was at most 2.2 meters long and weighed between 9.1 and 22.7 kilograms.
estimates.quote: An estimate by Holtz (2012) suggests that Daemonosaurus was at most 2.2 m long with a weight around that of a beaver, 9.1-22.7 kg.

estimates.statement: All known species of Dakosaurus were large, reaching about 4 to 5 meters in length with skulls and jaws up to 1 meter long.
estimates.quote: Description All currently known species would have been large, measuring approximately 4 - 5 m long, with skull and jaws approaching 1 m in length

estimates.statement: Dakotaraptor is exceptionally large for a dromaeosaurid, with an estimated adult length of 5.5 meters.
estimates.quote: Dakotaraptor es excepcionalmente grande para un dromeosáurido; se estima que la longitud de un adulto sería de 5.5 metros.

estimates.statement: Dakotaraptor was one of the largest dromaeosaurids, with estimates of 4.35 to 6 meters in length and 220 to 350 kilograms in weight.
estimates.quote: One of the largest dromaeosaurids, measuring 4.35 - 6 m and weighing 220 - 350 kg, the remains of D. steini were discovered in a multi-species bonebed.

estimates.statement: Daliansaurus was a small, lightly built, and likely feathered dinosaur about 1 meter long, similar in size to Sinovenator and Sinusonasus.
estimates.quote: Daliansaurus is a small, lightly-built, and most likely feathered troodontid measuring approximately 1 m in length, similar in size to Sinovenator and Sinusonasus.

estimates.statement: Daliansaurus was a small, lightly built troodontid that was likely feathered and measured approximately 1 meter in length.
estimates.quote: Daliansaurus es un pequeño troodóntido, ligeramente construido, y lo más probable emplumado que midió aproximadamente 1 metro de longitud

estimates.statement: Daliansaurus was a small troodontid theropod dinosaur about 1 meter long that lived in China during the Early Cretaceous.
estimates.quote: Daliansaurus (meaning "Dalian reptile") is a genus of small troodontid theropod dinosaur, measuring approximately 1 m long, from the Early Cretaceous of China.

estimates.statement: The holotype of Dasosaurus represents a medium-to-large sauropod approximately 20 meters long.
estimates.quote: The Dasosaurus holotype belongs to a medium-to-large sauropod, approximately 20 m long.

estimates.statement: One large specimen suggests Daspletosaurus could reach lengths of over 9 meters, potentially up to 11 meters and 4 to 5 metric tons in weight.
estimates.quote: However, one large specimen of Daspletosaurus sp. (CMC VP 15826) suggests that the genus could reach lengths of over 9 m, potentially reaching sizes of 11 m in length and 4 - 5 MT in weight.

estimates.statement: A Daspletosaurus specimen from the Coal Ridge Member of the Judith River Formation measuring about 11 meters long was reported in 2009.
estimates.quote: In 2009, preliminary preparation of a Daspletosaurus specimen from the Coal Ridge Member of the Judith River Formation measuring about 11 m long was reported.

estimates.statement: The largest potential Daspletosaurus specimen was estimated to be around 11 meters long and weigh up to 5 metric tons.
estimates.quote: Daspletosaurus era un gran depredador bípedo, y el espécimen potencial más grande medía alrededor de 11 metros de largo y pesaba hasta 5 toneladas métricas

estimates.statement: A potential D. torosus specimen nicknamed "Pete III" suggests the genus could reach nearly 11 meters in length and weigh 5 tons.
estimates.quote: Sin embargo, hay un espécimen potencial de D. torosus, CMC VP 15826, apodado "Pete III", sugiere que el género podría alcanzar longitudes de casi 11 metros y pesar 5 toneladas

estimates.statement: The average adult Daspletosaurus measured 8.5 to 9 meters in length and weighed between 2 and 3 metric tons.
estimates.quote: average adult measuring 8.5 – 9 m and weighing 2 - 3 MT

estimates.statement: Adult Daspletosaurus could reach a length of 8.5 to 9 meters, a hip height of 2.2 meters, and a mass of 2 to 3 metric tons.
estimates.quote: Adults could reach a length of 8.5 - 9 m from snout to tail, a hip height of 2.2 m, and a body mass of 2 - 3 MT.

estimates.statement: An adult Daspletosaurus measured approximately 8 to 9 meters in length with an estimated weight of 2.5 tons.
estimates.quote: Un Daspletosaurus adulto medía aproximadamente entre 8 y 9 metros de largo, con un peso estimado de 2,5 toneladas

estimates.statement: Deinocheirus was the largest ornithomimosaur, reaching 11 meters in length and weighing 6.5 tons.
estimates.quote: Deinocheirus was an unusual ornithomimosaur, the largest of the clade at 11 m long, and weighing 6.5 t.

estimates.statement: Deinocheirus is the largest known ornithomimosaur, with the largest specimen estimated to be 11 meters long and weigh 6.36 tons.
estimates.quote: Deinocheirus is the largest ornithomimosaurian (ostrich dinosaur) discovered; according to the 2014 description, the largest known specimen measured about 11 m long, with an estimated weight of 6.36 t.

estimates.statement: Deinocheirus was the largest member of its clade, reaching 11 meters in length and weighing 6.36 tonnes.
estimates.quote: Deinocheirus era un ornitomimosaurio inusual, el más grande del clado, con 11 metros de largo, y con 6,36 toneladas de peso.

estimates.statement: Gregory S. Paul estimated Deinocheirus could reach a length of 11.5 meters and a mass of 5 tons in 2016.
estimates.quote: In 2016, Gregory S. Paul presented a higher length estimate of 11.5 m but a lower mass estimate of 5 t.

estimates.statement: Thomas R. Holtz estimated the length of Deinocheirus to be 12 meters in 2012.
estimates.quote: Holtz estimated the length of Deinocheirus at 12 m in 2012.

estimates.statement: Deinonychus antirrhopus could grow up to 3.4 meters in length.
estimates.quote: This species, which could grow up to 3.4 m long

estimates.statement: This species could grow up to 3.4 meters in length.
estimates.quote: Esta especie podría crecer hasta 3,4 metros de longitud.

estimates.statement: Based on few fully mature specimens, Deinonychus could reach 3.4 meters in length, with a skull around 410 millimeters, a hip height of 87 centimeters, and a weight of 73 kg.
estimates.quote: Basado en los pocos ejemplares completamente maduros, Deinonychus podría alcanzar los 3,4 metros de largo, con un cráneo de alrededor de 410 milímetros, una altura de 87 centímetros a las caderas y un peso de 73 kg

estimates.statement: Based on mature specimens, Paul estimated Deinonychus reached 3.3 to 3.4 meters in length, had a 410 mm skull, 0.87 m hip height, and a mass of 60 to 73 kg.
estimates.quote: Based on the few fully mature specimens, Paul estimated that Deinonychus could reach 3.3 - 3.4 m in length, with a skull length of 410 mm, a hip height of 0.87 m and a body mass of 60 - 73 kg.

estimates.statement: A Texas specimen with a 1.31-meter skull suggested a total body length of 9.8 meters for Deinosuchus.
estimates.quote: A reasonably well-preserved skull specimen discovered in Texas indicated the animal's head measured about 1.31 m, and its body length was estimated at 9.8 m.

estimates.statement: A well-preserved skull found in Texas measured about 1.31 meters, leading Schwimmer to calculate a body length of 9.8 meters.
estimates.quote: Un cráneo razonablemente bien preservado descubierto en Texas indica que la cabeza del animal medía cerca de 1.31 metros, y a partir de este Schwimmer calculó una longitud corporal de 9.8 metros.

estimates.statement: Walter and colleagues (2025) argued previous size estimates were too high due to incorrect scaling, estimating maximum lengths of 10.5 m for D. riograndensis and 7.64 m for D. schwimmeri.
estimates.quote: In their 2025 reclassification of Deinosuchus as a non-crocodylian eusuchian, Walter and colleagues stated that previous estimates may have overestimated its size as the genus has a relatively long snout, but these were based on taxa with shorter snouts such as the American alligator. The authors estimated the maximum total body length of D. riograndensis and D. schwimmeri at 10.5 m and 7.64 m respectively.

estimates.statement: The largest known individuals of Deinosuchus surpassed 9 meters in total length.
estimates.quote: with the largest surpassing 9 m in total length

estimates.statement: A 1999 estimate based on more complete remains placed Deinosuchus between 8 and 10 meters long and weighing 2.5 to 5 metric tons.
estimates.quote: Using more complete remains, it was estimated in 1999 that the size attained by specimens of Deinosuchus varied from 8 to 10 m with weights from 2.5 to 5 MT.

estimates.statement: A specimen with a 147.5 cm skull was estimated to reach a total length of 10.64 meters using American alligator regression equations.
estimates.quote: A particularly large preserved skull from a D. riograndensis specimen was estimated to have come from an individual with a skull length of 147.5 cm. This length was used in conjunction with a regression equation relating skull length to total length in the American alligator to estimate a total length of 10.64 m for this particular specimen.

estimates.statement: Deinosuchus is among the largest crocodilians of all time, with length estimates ranging from 8 to 15 meters and a maximum estimated weight of 9 tons.
estimates.quote: Se encuentra entre los mayores crocodilianos de todos los tiempos; las estimaciones sobre su longitud varían de 8 a 15 metros y un peso máximo estimado de 9 toneladas

estimates.statement: Iijima and Kubo (2020) estimated the type specimen AMNH 3073 measured between 7.37 and 8.17 meters long.
estimates.quote: Iijima and Kubo (2020) estimated AMNH 3073 to measure 7.37 - 8.17 m in length using regression equations based on modern crocodilians, as the vertebrae of crocodilians scale with positive allometry.

estimates.statement: Schwimmer (2002) suggested the largest D. riograndensis could reach 12 meters and weigh nearly 8.5 metric tons.
estimates.quote: Schwimmer (2002) suggested the very largest individuals of D. riograndensis could reach sizes up to 12 m, 1.5 times that of the average D. rugosus, based on isometrically scaling vertebral lengths from the type specimens of "Phobosuchus riograndensis" (AMNH 3073) and Deinosuchus hatcheri, which he estimated would represent animals nearly 8.5 MT.

estimates.statement: Schwimmer estimates that the largest specimens had a total body length of over 12 meters and possibly weighed 8.5 tons or more.
estimates.quote: Schwimmer estima que los mayores especímenes tenían una longitud corporal total de más de 12 metros, y quizás pesaban unas 8.5 toneladas o más.

estimates.statement: Walter and colleagues suggested a likely 95th percentile length of 7.66 m for D. riograndensis and 6.37 m for D. schwimmeri, with mean lengths of 5.8 m and 4.83 m respectively.
estimates.quote: They suggested a 95 percentile body length estimate, which they considered more likely, of 7.66 m and 6.37 m respectively and a mean body length of 5.8 m and 4.83 m respectively, although the authors stated that D. riograndensis specimen AMNH 3073 would have been larger than the specimens used in the study.

estimates.statement: Based on the holotype, Deltadromeus was approximately 8 meters long and weighed 1050 kilograms.
