estimates.quote: El holotipo adulto, espécimen IGM 100/11, tenía aproximadamente 6 metros de largo y 1,9 metros de altura en la cadera.

estimates.statement: The known specimen of Garudimimus measured nearly 3.5 meters in length and weighed between 77.3 and 98 kilograms.
estimates.quote: The only known specimen of Garudimimus was a medium-sized animal measuring nearly 3.5 m in length and weighing about 77.3 - 98 kg.

estimates.statement: The holotype specimen of Giganotosaurus has been estimated to be between 12 and 13 meters long.
estimates.quote: Length estimates for the holotype specimen have varied between 12 and 13 m

estimates.statement: Giganotosaurus is one of the largest known theropods, estimated to reach lengths of 12 to 13 meters, a skull over 1.60 meters long, and a weight of 7 to 8 tons.
estimates.quote: Es uno de los mayores terópodos conocidos; se cree que alcanzaba longitudes de entre 12 a 13 m, con un cráneo de posiblemente de más de 1,60m de largo y un peso aproximado de entre 7 a 8tn.

estimates.statement: Based on the holotype MUCPv-CH-1, studies estimate Giganotosaurus at 12 to 13 meters long, 6.1 to 6.9 tons, and over 4 meters high at the hips.
estimates.quote: Basándose en el holotipo, MUCPv-CH-1, diferentes estudios a lo largo de los años han estimado al Giganotosaurus en un rango de entre 12 y 13 m de longitud, de 6,1 a 6,9 tn de peso, y con una altura superior a unos 4 m hasta las caderas.

estimates.statement: If the second specimen represents a larger individual, estimates project a length of 13.2 to 13.5 meters and a weight of 8.2 to 8.7 tons.
estimates.quote: Esto podría indicar que el Giganotosaurus alcanzaba mayores tamaños. Los estimados han proyectado dimensiones de 13,2 a 13,5 m de largo y 8,2 a 8,7 tn de peso.

estimates.statement: In 1997, Coria estimated Giganotosaurus to be 13.7 to 14.3 meters long and weigh 8 to 10 metric tons, larger than Carcharodontosaurus.
estimates.quote: In a 1997 interview, Coria estimated Giganotosaurus to have been 13.7 (45 ft) to 14.3 (47 ft) m long and weighing 8 to 10 MT based on new material, larger than Carcharodontosaurus.

estimates.statement: Recent analysis of pelvic dimensions supports an original 1995 estimate that Giganotosaurus was 12.5 meters long.
estimates.quote: Based on this idea, he found Giganotosaurus to have been 12.5 m long, identical to the estimate proposed in the 1995 description.

estimates.statement: Gigantoraptor was the largest known oviraptorosaur, with estimates of 8 to 8.6 meters in length and 1.4 to 2 metric tons in body mass.
estimates.quote: Gigantoraptor was the largest-known oviraptorosaur, reaching 8 or 8.6 m in length and 1.4 - 2 MT in body mass.

estimates.statement: Gigantoraptor was approximately three times longer and 35 times heavier than Citipati, with estimates of 8 meters in length, 3.5 meters at the hips, and 1.4 metric tons in weight.
estimates.quote: Approximately three times as long and 35 times heavier than the largest earlier-discovered oviraptorosaur Citipati, the holotype of Gigantoraptor has been estimated at 8 m long with a height of 3.5 m at the hips, and a ponderous weight of 1.4 MT.

estimates.statement: Xu et al. estimated the length of Gigantoraptor at 8 meters and the weight at 1400 kilograms.
estimates.quote: Xu et al. estimó la longitud en 8 metros y el peso en 1400 kilogramos

estimates.statement: Other studies have estimated Gigantoraptor's weight at 2 metric tons and its length at 8.6 meters.
estimates.quote: Other studies have estimated it to be 2 MT in weight, and one at 8.6 m in length.

estimates.statement: Gilmoreosaurus was a large hadrosauroid that could grow up to 6.2 meters long and weigh between 1.2 and 3.6 tons.
estimates.quote: Gilmoreosaurus was a relatively large-sized hadrosauroid which could grow up to 6.2 m long and obtain weights between 1.2 to 3.6 t.

estimates.statement: Nanotyrannus measured around 5.5 meters in length and 2 meters in height, about one-third the size of Tyrannosaurus.
estimates.quote: Solo medía alrededor de 5,5 metros de longitud y 2 de altura, un tercio del tamaño de Tyrannosaurus.

estimates.statement: Specimen HMN XV2, with a fibula 13% larger than that of HMN SII, is estimated to have been 23 to 26 meters long and weighed 40 to 48 metric tons.
estimates.quote: specimen HMN XV2, represented by a fibula 13% larger than the corresponding material on HMN SII, would have measured around 23 - 26 m long and weighed about 40 - 48 MT

estimates.statement: A 2020 study estimated the largest specimen to be 25 meters long, 48 tonnes, and 6.8 meters tall at the shoulder.
estimates.quote: In 2020, Molina-Perez and Larramnedi estimated the size of the HMN XV2 specimen at 25 m and 48 t, with a shoulder height of 6.8 m.

estimates.statement: The largest known specimen is HMN XV2, which has a fibula 13% larger than that of the Berlin mount and may have reached 26 meters in length.
estimates.quote: HMN SII is not the largest specimen known (an assertion supported by its subadult status) but HMN XV2, represented by a fibula 13% larger than the corresponding material on HMN SII, which might have attained 26 m in length.

estimates.statement: Based on the nearly complete holotype specimen HMN SII housed in the Berlin Natural History Museum, Giraffatitan is estimated to have reached 21.8 to 23 meters in length and 13 meters in height.
estimates.quote: Basándose en el espécimen holotipo, HMN SII, conocido por un esqueleto casi completo que se expone en el Museo de Historia Natural de Berlín, Giraffatitan se estima que alcanzó entre 21,8 y 23 metros de longitud y probablemente medía 13 metros de altura hasta la cabeza.

estimates.statement: The frequently cited length of 22.46 meters was an addition error by the describer Werner Janensch; the correct length is 22.16 meters.
estimates.quote: The often mentioned length of 22.46 m is by Werner Janensch, the German scientist who described Giraffatitan, and was the result of an adding error: the correct number should have been 22.16 m.

estimates.statement: The estimated total length of Glacialisaurus is 6.2 meters.
estimates.quote: Its length has been estimated at 6.2 m.

estimates.statement: Globidens was a medium-sized mosasaur that measured approximately 5 to 6 meters in length.
estimates.quote: Globidens was a relatively medium-sized mosasaur, measuring about 5 - 6 m long.

estimates.statement: Globidens reached a length of 6 meters.
estimates.quote: Globidens medía 6 m de longitud

estimates.statement: Gojirasaurus was one of the largest Triassic theropods, reaching 5.5 to 6 meters in length and weighing at least 150 kg.
estimates.quote: Gojirasaurus is one of the largest theropods known from the Triassic Period, with an estimate total length of 5.5 - 6 m long and a weight of at least 150 kg.

estimates.statement: Adult Gojirasaurus could have reached a length of 6.5 meters.
estimates.quote: Un adulto pudo haber medido 6,5 metros

estimates.statement: Adult Gorgosaurus measured 8 to 9 meters in length and weighed between 2 and 3 metric tons.
estimates.quote: Adults reached 8 to 9 m in length from snout to tail, and weighed 2 - 3 MT in body mass.

estimates.statement: Goronyosaurus is a small mosasaur that measured up to 5.14 meters in length.
estimates.quote: Goronyosaurus is a small mosasaur, measuring up to 5.14 m long

estimates.statement: Soliar derived a body length estimate of 5.14 meters from a skull length of 0.71 meters.
estimates.quote: Soliar (1988) derived a body length estimate of 5.14 m from a 0.71 m long skull

estimates.statement: Goronyosaurus reached a length of about seven meters with a skull measuring 62 centimeters.
estimates.quote: Goronyosaurus medía unos siete metros de largo, con un cráneo que alcanzaba los 62 centímetros de longitud.

estimates.statement: The animal was small, measuring about 70 centimeters in length and 30 centimeters in height.
estimates.quote: Animal de pequeñas dimensiones, media alrededor de 70 centímetros de largo por 30 de alto

estimates.statement: The type specimen of Gryposaurus notabilis represents an animal approximately 8.2 meters in length.
estimates.quote: one of the best specimens of this genus, the nearly complete type specimen of Kritosaurus incurvimanus (now regarded as a synonym of Gryposaurus notabilis) came from an animal about 8.2 m long.

estimates.statement: Gryposaurus was a large herbivore that could walk on two or four legs and measured around 8 meters in length.
estimates.quote: A large bipedal/quadrupedal herbivore around 8 m long, it may have preferred river settings.

estimates.statement: Gregory S. Paul estimated Gryposaurus notabilis and G. monumentensis to be 8 meters long with a body mass of 3 metric tons.
estimates.quote: the other two species (G. notabilis and G. monumentensis) at 8 m in length and 3 MT in body mass

estimates.statement: Gregory S. Paul estimated Gryposaurus latidens to be 7.5 meters long with a body mass of 2.5 metric tons.
estimates.quote: Gregory S. Paul estimated the size of G. latidens at 7.5 m in length and 2.5 MT in body mass

estimates.statement: Gryposaurus was a large herbivore about 9 meters long that could move bipedally or quadrupedally and preferred living near rivers.
estimates.quote: Fue un gran herbívoro que podía avanzar de forma bípeda como cuadrúpeda de alrededor de 9 metros de largo, que preferiría vivir junto a los ríos.

estimates.statement: Gryposaurus was a typical-sized hadrosaurid measuring approximately 9 meters long and 4 meters high.
estimates.quote: Gryposaurus era un hadrosaúrido de tamaño y forma típicos, medía aproximadamente 9 metros de largo y 4 de alto.

estimates.statement: The most robust known species, G. monumentensis, may have reached 10 meters in length.
estimates.quote: De las cuatro especies conocidas la más robusta es G. monumentensis que puede haber llegado a los 10 metros.

estimates.statement: Based on orbital skeleton measurements, G. croizati is estimated to have reached a total length of 10.15 meters and a mass of approximately 1,745 kilograms.
estimates.quote: Basándose en las medidas del esqueleto orbital, se ha estimado que la longitud total del animal llegaba a los 10.15 metros, con una masa total de cerca de 1.745 kilogramos.

estimates.statement: Some reported specimens of Guizhouichthyosaurus reached a total length of around 7 meters.
estimates.quote: Additionally, specimens of Guizhouichthyosaurus reaching around 7 m in total length have also been reported.

estimates.statement: Size estimates based on 86 presacral and 110 caudal vertebrae result in a total length of 10 meters.
estimates.quote: La estimaciones de tamaño basadas en la colección preservada de 86vértebras presacrales y 110caudales dan como resultado una longitud total de 10metros.

estimates.statement: Hadrosaurus were large animals that ranged from 7 to 8 meters in length and weighed between 2 and 4 tonnes.
estimates.quote: They were large animals ranging from 7 to 8 m in length and 2 to 4 t in weight.

estimates.statement: Hadrosaurus is estimated to have been about 8 meters long, 3 meters tall, and weighed 3 tons.
estimates.quote: Se estima que midió unos 8 metros de longitud y entre 3 de altura, pesando 3 toneladas

estimates.statement: Hallopus was a small animal reaching about 1 meter (3.3 feet) in length with long and slender limbs.
estimates.quote: It was a quite small animal, reaching a length of 1 m (3.3ft) with long and slender limbs.

estimates.statement: Based on comparisons with other sphenosuchians, the body length of Hallopus is estimated to be approximately 62 cm.
estimates.quote: Using the proportions of various sphenosuchians, especially Pedeticosaurus, Walker estimates a total body length of approximately 62 cm.

estimates.statement: Halszkaraptor was about 60 centimeters long, roughly the size of a mallard duck.
estimates.quote: Halszkaraptor tenía un tamaño cercano al de un ánade real, alrededor de 60 centímetros de largo

estimates.statement: Hanosaurus was a small marine reptile about 79.4 cm long that likely ate soft-bodied prey.
estimates.quote: It was a small animal, with specimens measuring 79.4 cm long in total body length, which likely fed on soft-bodied prey.

estimates.statement: Gregory S. Paul estimated Haplocheirus was about 2 meters long and weighed 21 kilograms.
estimates.quote: Gregory S. Paul estimated that it was about 2 m long and weighed about 21 kg.

estimates.statement: Haplocheirus is one of the largest known definitive alvarezsauroids, measuring 1.9 to 2.3 meters in length and weighing up to 10.56 kilograms.
estimates.quote: Haplocheirus es uno de los mayores alvarezsauroides definitivos conocidos, con 1,9 a 2,3 metros de largo y alcanzando un peso de 10,56 kilogramos

estimates.statement: Helicoprion is estimated to have grown between 5 and 12 meters in length.
estimates.quote: Helicoprion is estimated to have reached lengths between 5 and 12 m

estimates.statement: Comparisons with other eugeneodontids suggest Helicoprion may have reached a length of about 7 meters.
estimates.quote: Al compararlo con otros eugeneodóntidos, se piensa que el Helicoprion pudo haber alcanzado una talla de unos 7 metros de largo.

estimates.statement: Tapanila suggested that the largest Helicoprion individuals could have reached 9.7-12 meters in length.
estimates.quote: Tapanila has suggested a total length of 9.7-12 m for the largest Helicoprion individuals.

estimates.statement: Herrerasaurus measured about 6 meters in length and weighed approximately 350 kilograms.
estimates.quote: Measuring 6 m long and weighing around 350 kg, this genus was one of the earliest dinosaurs from the fossil record.

estimates.statement: Smaller specimens of Herrerasaurus measured approximately 4.5 meters in length and weighed about 200 kilograms.
estimates.quote: Smaller specimens were about 4.5 m long and weighed about 200 kg.

estimates.statement: Herrerasaurus had a femur length of about 50 centimeters, a total length between 3 and 6 meters, a hip height of 1.1 meters, and a weight between 210 and 350 kilograms.
estimates.quote: Presenta un tamaño medio, con el fémur de unos 50 centímetros de longitud, y un largo total de entre 3 y 6 metros, y una altura a las caderas de 1,1 metros, llegando a pesar entre 210 a 350 kilogramos.

estimates.statement: Adult Herrerasaurus reached lengths of up to 6 meters and weighed up to 350 kilograms.
estimates.quote: Los adultos tenían cráneos de hasta 56 centímetros de largo y tenían hasta 6 metros de longitud total y 350 kilogramos de peso.

estimates.statement: Hesperornis was a large bird measuring between 1.5 and 2 meters in length and weighing approximately 10.6 kilograms.
estimates.quote: Hesperornis was a large bird, measuring about 1.5 - 2 m long and weighing around 10.6 kg

estimates.statement: Hesperornis rossicus was about 1.4 meters long, making it the largest species of Hesperornis and one of the largest hesperornithines, though slightly smaller than the Canadian genus Canadaga.
estimates.quote: At about 1.4 m long, H. rossicus was the largest species of Hesperornis and among the largest hesperornithines, slightly smaller than the large Canadian genus Canadaga.

estimates.statement: Hesperornis rossicus was about 1.4 meters long and was the largest species of Hesperornis.
estimates.quote: Con cerca de 1.4 metros de largo, H. rossicus fue la mayor especie de Hesperornis

estimates.statement: Hesperornis was a large bird reaching up to 1.8 meters in length.
estimates.quote: Eran aves de gran tamaño, de hasta 1,8 metros de longitud.

estimates.statement: Hesperosaurus was a large stegosaur that reached 6.5 meters in length and 3.5 metric tons in body mass.
estimates.quote: Hesperosaurus was a large stegosaur, reaching 6.5 m in length and 3.5 MT in body mass.

estimates.statement: In 2010, Gregory S. Paul estimated Hesperosaurus to be 6.5 meters long and weigh 3.5 tons.
estimates.quote: En 2010, Gregory S. Paul estimó su longitud en 6,5 metros, el peso en 3,5 toneladas.

estimates.statement: The most complete skeleton of Heterodontosaurus measured approximately 1.18 meters in length.
estimates.quote: The most complete skeleton, SAM-PK-K1332, belonged to an animal measuring about 1.18 m in length.

estimates.statement: The most complete skeleton of Heterodontosaurus, SAM-PK-K1332, belonged to an animal measuring approximately 1.18 meters in length.
estimates.quote: El esqueleto más completo, SAM-PK-K1332, pertenecía a un animal que medía aproximadamente 1.18 metros de longitud.

estimates.statement: Heterodontosaurus was a small dinosaur that grew between 1.18 and 1.75 meters long and weighed between 2 and 10 kilograms.
estimates.quote: Though it was a small dinosaur, Heterodontosaurus was one of the largest members of its family, reaching between 1.18 m and possibly 1.75 m in length, and weighing between 2 and 10 kg.

estimates.statement: Heterodontosaurus was a small dinosaur that grew between 1.20 and possibly 1.75 meters long and weighed between 2 and 10 kilograms.
estimates.quote: Aunque era un dinosaurio pequeño, Heterodontosaurus era uno de los miembros más grandes de su familia, alcanzaba entre 1,20 metros y posiblemente 1,75 metros de longitud y pesaba entre 2 y 10 kilogramos.

estimates.statement: A juvenile Heterodontosaurus skull measured 45 mm, suggesting a total body length of 450 mm if adult proportions applied.
estimates.quote: The length of the juvenile skull was suggested to be 45 mm. Assuming similar body proportions as adult individuals, the body length of this juvenile would have been 450 mm

estimates.statement: Assuming body proportions similar to adults, the juvenile's body length would have been 450 mm.
estimates.quote: Suponiendo proporciones corporales similares a las de los adultos, la longitud corporal de este juvenil habría sido de 450 milímetros.
estimates.source_title: Heterodontosaurus tucki (El crecimiento y la ontogenia)

estimates.statement: Huabeisaurus was estimated to be 20 meters long and 5 meters high.
estimates.quote: Huabeisaurus measures 20 m long and 5 m high, as estimated by Pang and Cheng in 2000.

estimates.statement: Huabeisaurus measured 20 meters in total length, making it large compared to most dinosaurs but only midsized by sauropod standards.
estimates.quote: Measuring 20 m in total length, Huabeisaurus is large when compared to most dinosaurs, but by sauropod standards, it was only midsized.

estimates.statement: Huabeisaurus reached a total length of 20 meters, which is large compared to most dinosaurs but only medium-sized among sauropods.
estimates.quote: Con una longitud total de 20 metros, el Huabeisaurus es grande en comparación con la mayoría de los dinosaurios, pero según los estándares de saurópodos, solo era de tamaño mediano.

estimates.statement: Hudiesaurus is considered one of the largest dinosaurs, with estimates reaching 32 meters in length and 55 tonnes in mass.
estimates.quote: Hudiesaurus is one of the largest dinosaurs known, possibly reaching 32 m in length and 55 tonne in body mass.

estimates.statement: Researchers Rubén Molina-Pérez and Asier Larremendi estimated Hudiesaurus at 30.5 meters long and 44 tonnes if the vertebra is dorsal.
estimates.quote: In their book Dinosaurs Facts and Figures, researchers Rubén Molina-Pérez and Asier Larremendi estimated Hudiesaurus to be 30.5 m in length with a shoulder height of 5.5 m and mass of 44 tonne if the vertebra is a dorsal vertebra.

estimates.statement: Molina-Pérez and Larremendi noted that if the vertebra is cervical, Hudiesaurus would reach 32 meters in length and 55 tonnes in weight.
estimates.quote: However, they noted that if the vertebra is a cervical vertebra, its length would be 32 m and its weight 55 tonne.

estimates.statement: Gregory S. Paul estimated Hudiesaurus to be 25 meters long and weigh 25 tonnes in 2016.
estimates.quote: In 2016, Gregory S. Paul estimated its length at 25 m and its weight at 25 tonne.

estimates.statement: Researchers estimate that Huinculsaurus was around 3.42 meters long in life.
estimates.quote: Researchers have estimated that in life, it was around 3.42 m long.

estimates.statement: Gregory S. Paul estimated in 2010 that Hylaeosaurus was 5 meters long and weighed 2 tonnes.
estimates.quote: Gregory S. Paul in 2010 estimated the length at 5 m, the weight at 2 tonne.

estimates.statement: In 2001, Darren Naish and colleagues estimated the length of Hylaeosaurus at 3 to 4 meters.
estimates.quote: Some estimates are considerably lower: in 2001 Darren Naish e.a. gave a length of 3-4 m.

estimates.statement: Gideon Mantell originally estimated that Hylaeosaurus was about 7.6 meters long.
estimates.quote: Gideon Mantell originally estimated that Hylaeosaurus was about 7.6 m long, or about half the size of the other two original dinosaurs, Iguanodon and Megalosaurus.

estimates.statement: Hypacrosaurus is estimated to have been around 9.1 meters long and weighed up to 4.0 tonnes.
estimates.quote: The animal is estimated to have been around 9.1 m long, and to have weighed up to 4.0 tonnes (4.4 tons).

estimates.statement: The animal measured around 9.10 meters in length and had an estimated weight of 4 tons.
estimates.quote: El animal media alrededor de 9,10 metros de largo, y un peso estimado de 4 toneladas.

estimates.statement: Typical specimens of Hypsilophodon are about 1.5 meters long.
estimates.quote: Typical specimens are about 1.5 m long.

estimates.statement: Typical specimens of Hypsilophodon measure around 1.5 meters in length.
estimates.quote: Los especímenes típicos miden alrededor de 1,5 metros de largo.

estimates.statement: Hypsilophodon could reach lengths of up to 1.8 meters, weighed about 20 kilograms, and was an agile runner.
estimates.quote: Hypsilophodon alcanzó hasta 1,8 metros de largo, pesaba unos 20 kilogramos y era un corredor ágil.

estimates.statement: Hypsilophodon was often cited as reaching a maximum length of 2.3 meters.
estimates.quote: Para el Hypsilophodon a menudo se indica una longitud máxima de 2,3 metros.

estimates.statement: In 2009, Galton concluded that a previously attributed femur belonged to Valdosaurus, reducing the known maximum length of Hypsilophodon to 1.8 meters.
estimates.quote: en 2009, Galton concluyó que, de hecho, este fémur pertenecía a Valdosaurus y reducía el tamaño de Hypsilophodon a una longitud máxima conocida de 1,8 metros

estimates.statement: Early studies incorrectly suggested that Hypsilophodon could climb trees, had armor, reached lengths of 2.3 meters, and existed outside of the Isle of Wight.
estimates.quote: Los estudios más antiguos han dado lugar a una serie de ideas erróneas sobre el Hypsilophodon, que era capaz trepar a los árboles, que estaba blindado, que alcanzaba una longitud de 2,3 metros y su presencia fuera de Wight.

estimates.statement: An average Ichthyornis specimen was about 24 cm long with a skeletal wingspan of approximately 43 cm.
estimates.quote: An average specimen was the size of a pigeon, 24 cm long, with a skeletal wingspan (not taking feathers into account) of around 43 cm

estimates.statement: Ichthyornis had an average size similar to a pigeon, measuring 24 centimeters in length with a wingspan of about 43 centimeters excluding feather length.
estimates.quote: Tenía un tamaño promedio similar al de una paloma, de 24 centímetros de largo, con una envergadura alar (sin contar la longitud de las plumas que tenía en vida) de cerca de 43 cm

estimates.statement: The type species I. communis reached up to 2 meters in length, while other species varied, with I. larkini up to 2.5 meters, I. anningae up to 1.8 meters, I. breviceps up to 1.9 meters, and I. conybeari up to 1.5 meters.
estimates.quote: I. communis reaching up to 2 m in length, I. larkini probably up to 2.5 m, I. anningae up to 1.8 m, I. breviceps up to 1.9 m, and I. conybeari up to 1.5 m.

estimates.statement: Ichthyotitan is estimated to have reached nearly 25 meters in length, making it the largest known marine reptile.
estimates.quote: Estimates scaling up the bones from other ichthyosaur species put Ichthyotitan body length at nearly 25 m, which would make it the largest marine reptile currently known.

estimates.statement: Revised anatomical comparisons suggest Ichthyotitan was 25 meters long, likely the largest marine reptile ever described.
estimates.quote: Comparing the position of the MAME process in the BAS specimen to that in Besanosaurus, they provided a revised length estimate of 25 m, likely making it the largest marine reptile ever described.

estimates.statement: Ichthyotitan is estimated to have reached a body length of nearly 25 meters, potentially making it the largest known marine reptile.
estimates.quote: Pudo haber tenido una longitud corporal cercana a los 25 metros, lo que lo convertiría en el reptil marino más grande conocido a la fecha.

estimates.statement: Scaling based on Besanosaurus yielded a shorter length estimate of 22 meters.
estimates.quote: Sin embargo, la escala basada en Besanosaurus encontró una estimación de longitud más corta, de 22 metros.

estimates.statement: Tentatively linked Aust specimens are informally estimated to be even larger, reaching 30 to 35 meters in length.
estimates.quote: The Aust specimens, tentatively linked to Ichthyotitan, have been informally estimated to be even larger at 30 to 35 m long.

estimates.statement: In 2016, Gregory S. Paul estimated Ichthyovenator was approximately 8.5 meters long and weighed 2 tons.
estimates.quote: In 2016, Gregory S. Paul estimated Ichthyovenator to have been approximately 8.5 m long and to have weighed 2 t.

estimates.statement: In 2016, Gregory S. Paul estimated Ichthyovenator to be 8.5 meters long and weigh 2 tons.
estimates.quote: En 2016, Gregory S. Paul estimó que Ichthyovenator tenía 8,5 metros de largo y un peso de 2 toneladas.

estimates.statement: The holotype specimen of Ichthyovenator is estimated to have been 8.5 to 10.5 meters long and weighed 2.4 tons.
estimates.quote: The holotype specimen is estimated to have been between 8.5 to 10.5 m long and to have weighed 2.4 t

estimates.statement: Iguanodon was a large, bulky herbivore that could reach lengths of 9 to 11 meters and weigh up to 4.5 metric tons.
estimates.quote: Iguanodon was a large, bulky herbivore, measuring up to 9 - 11 m in length and 4.5 MT in body mass

estimates.statement: The species I. bernissartensis is estimated to have been about 9 meters long as an adult, with a maximum reported length of 11 meters.
estimates.quote: The only well-supported species, I. bernissartensis, is estimated to have measured about 9 m long as an adult, with some specimens possibly as long as 13 m, although this is likely an overestimate, given that the maximum body length of I. bernissartensis is reported to be 11 m.

estimates.statement: Adults of the best-known species, I. bernissartensis, are estimated to have weighed an average of 3 tons and measured about 10 meters long, reaching up to 13 meters in some cases.
estimates.quote: Se ha estimado que los adultos de la especie mejor conocida, I. bernissartensis, pesaban un promedio de 3 toneladas, y medían cerca de 10 metros de largo, pudiendo alcanzar en algunos casos los 13 metros.

estimates.statement: A find in Nehden, Germany, included at least 15 individuals ranging from 2 to 8 meters in length, mostly Mantellisaurus (formerly I. atherfieldensis) with some I. bernissartensis.
estimates.quote: At least 15 individuals, from 2 to 8 m long, have been found here, most of the individuals belong to the related Mantellisaurus (described as I. atherfieldensis, at that time believed to be another species of Iguanodon). but some are of I. bernissartensis.
estimates.source_title: Iguanodon (Turn of the century and the Dinosaur Renaissance)

estimates.statement: Reexaminations of specific bones revised the estimated body length of Imperobator to between 2 and 3 meters.
estimates.quote: reexaminations of the phalanx III-1 and distal metatarsal III of Imperobator suggested that they were much smaller than those of Austroraptor and more similar in size to those of Neuquenraptor and Deinonychus, which led to the revision of its body length estimate to around 2 - 3 m

estimates.statement: The holotype specimen of Imperobator measures approximately 45 centimeters in length.
estimates.quote: The holotype specimen measures approximately 45 cm in length

estimates.statement: The largest known specimens of Iniopteryx measure between 30 and 35 centimeters in length.
estimates.quote: PF6678 and PF6645 are the largest specimens of Iniopteryx and are between 30 and 35 centimeters in length.

estimates.statement: Invictibellatrix is estimated to have had a body mass of 200 to 300 kg and a body length of approximately 4 meters.
estimates.quote: Invictibellatrix is estimated to have a body mass between 200–300 kg and a body length of around 4 m.

estimates.statement: Gregory S. Paul estimated Irritator's length at 7.5 meters and weight at 1 ton.
estimates.quote: Gregory S. Paul calculated its length at 7.5 m and weight at 1 t.

estimates.statement: Gregory S. Paul estimated the maximum length of Irritator at 7.5 meters and its weight at 1 tonne.

estimates.statement: K. molnari was described as reaching lengths between 3 and 4 meters.

estimates.statement: Kayrasaurus is a medium-sized therizinosaur with a body length of at least 3.6 meters.
estimates.quote: Kayrasaurus se considera un terizinosaurio de tamaño mediano, con una longitud corporal de al menos 3,6 metros.

estimates.statement: Kayrasaurus is substantially larger than Beipiaosaurus, which has an estimated body length of 2.2 meters.
estimates.quote: Estas medidas lo hacen sustancialmente más grande que Beipiaosaurus, el siguiente terizinosaurio más grande conocido de la Biota de Jehol, que tiene una longitud corporal estimada de 2,2 m (7,2 ft).

estimates.statement: Adult Kentrosaurus generally measured around 4.5 meters in length and weighed approximately 1.1 tons.

estimates.statement: Adult Kentrosaurus measured approximately 4 to 4.5 meters in length and weighed between 700 and 1600 kilograms.
estimates.quote: Kentrosaurus generally measured around 4 - 4.5 m in length as an adult, and weighed about 700 - 1600 kg.

estimates.statement: Individual fossil elements suggest Kentrosaurus could have reached a total length of 5.5 meters.
estimates.quote: Se encontraron elementos individuales más grandes, de modo que el animal probablemente podría alcanzar una longitud total de 5,5 metros.

estimates.statement: Later estimates suggest Kinnareemimus was about 1.8 meters long and weighed approximately 13 kilograms.
estimates.quote: It has subsequently been estimated by Molina-Pérez and Larramendi to have been about 1.8 m long and would have possibly weighed around 13 kg.

estimates.statement: Klamelisaurus was approximately 13 meters long, with its neck accounting for half of its total length.

estimates.statement: In 2010, Gregory S. Paul estimated its length at 15 meters and weight at 5 tons, assuming it represented the adult form of Bellusaurus.

estimates.statement: Zhao estimated that Klamelisaurus originally had sixty tail vertebrae with a total length of 6.55 meters based on his count of preserved elements.
estimates.quote: Zhao originally counted two complete caudals, ten neural spines from the front, and ten middle centra, based on which he estimated that sixty were originally present with a total length of 6.55 m.

estimates.statement: Knoetschkesuchus was a small, short-snouted crocodilian measuring approximately 55 cm in length.
estimates.quote: Knoetschkesuchus was a small and short-snouted crocodilian, measuring about 55 cm in length

estimates.quote: Creciendo hasta aproximadamente 2 metros de longitud, Krabisuchus era un aligatorino pequeño que era menor que el actual aligátor

estimates.statement: A partial skeleton from the Sabinas Basin is around 11 meters long, about 20% larger than other known specimens, and represents one of the largest well-documented North American saurolophines.
estimates.quote: This skeleton is about 20% larger than other known specimens, around 11 meters [36 ft] long, and with a distinctively curved ischium, and represents one of the largest known well-documented North American saurolophines.

estimates.statement: The remains indicate that Kritosaurus reached a body length of 9 meters and a mass of 4 metric tons.

estimates.quote: Currently, the largest marine reptile identified to date is the Late Triassic ichthyosaur Ichthyotitan, which is thought to have reached around 25 m in length.

estimates.quote: La longitud de Kronosaurus fue estimada inicialmente en 12,8 metros. Sin embargo, estudios recientes comparando especímenes fósiles de Kronosaurus con otros pliosaurios sugieren que la estimación anterior era exagerada, con una longitud real probable de solo 9 a 10 metros.

estimates.statement: Kryptops is estimated to have been between 6 and 7 meters in length.

estimates.statement: Adult Lambeosaurus reached lengths of 7 to 7.7 meters and weighed between 2.6 and 3.4 tonnes.

estimates.statement: Nanotyrannus measured around 5.5 meters in length and 2 meters in height, about one-third the size of Tyrannosaurus.

estimates.statement: Mantellisaurus reached a length of 7 meters and a weight of 750 kilograms.
estimates.quote: Alcanzó los 7 metros de largo y 750 kilogramos de peso.

estimates.statement: Later studies revised the maximum size estimates for Mapusaurus to between 10.2 and 12.6 meters in length and 6 to 8 tons in mass.
estimates.quote: Subsequent works have given maximum size estimates of 10.2 - 12.6 m and 6 - 8 t, respectively.

estimates.statement: Mapusaurus was a large theropod similar in size to Giganotosaurus, with known individuals reaching approximately 10.2 meters in length and weighing about three tonnes.
estimates.quote: Mapusaurus era un gran terópodo y era más o menos similar en tamaño a su pariente cercano Giganotosaurus, con los individuos más grandes conocidos de aproximadamente 10,2 m de longitud o más y un peso de aproximadamente tres toneladas.

estimates.statement: Based on the largest specimen found, Mapusaurus is estimated to have been 12.2 to 12.6 meters long and weighed up to 6.8 tonnes.
estimates.quote: Basándose en las proporciones del espécimen más grande encontrado, se ha estimado que Mapusaurus roseae medía de 12,2 a 12,6 m de longitud y que pesaba hasta 6,8 toneladas.

estimates.statement: Coria and Currie estimated that Mapusaurus specimens in the bonebed ranged from 5.5 to 10.2 meters in length.
estimates.quote: In their paper describing Mapusaurus, Coria and Currie estimated that the specimens found in the bonebed measured between 5.5–10.2 m in length.

estimates.statement: The largest known Mapusaurus specimen, identified by a left femur, was originally estimated to reach 10.2 meters in length and weigh 3 tons.
estimates.quote: Based on the biggest specimen known from the bonebed, represented by a left femur, it was originally estimated to have reached a maximum body length of 10.2 m and a mass of 3 t.

estimates.statement: The largest historical estimate placed its length at 58 meters and mass at 150 tonnes.
estimates.quote: the largest estimate M. fragillimus to have been the longest known animal at 58 m in length with a mass of 150 tonne.

estimates.statement: Marasuchus was a small predator only 40 centimeters long.
estimates.quote: Era un pequeño depredador de solo 40 centímetros de largo.

estimates.statement: The Mascarene parrot measured 35 cm in length.
estimates.quote: The Mascarene parrot was 35 cm in length.

estimates.statement: Massospondylus was 4 to 6 meters long with a long neck and tail, small head, and slender body.
estimates.quote: The genus was 4 - 6 m long, with a long neck and tail, a small head, and a slender body

estimates.statement: A 2019 study estimated the largest known specimen of Massospondylus to be approximately 5 meters long.
estimates.quote: In 2019, Barrett and colleagues estimated the particularly large neotype specimen at around 5 m in length.

estimates.statement: Massospondylus reached about 4 meters in length and weighed approximately 135 kg, though some estimates suggest it could be 6 meters long.
estimates.quote: Este dinosaurio alcanzaba alrededor de los 4m, y peso aproximadamente 135kg, aunque algunas estimaciones sugieren unos 6m de largo

estimates.statement: Gregory S. Paul estimated the length of Massospondylus to be 4.3 meters in a 2024 publication.
estimates.quote: Gregory S. Paul, in a popular book published in 2024, estimated Massospondylus to be 4.3 m in length.

estimates.statement: Massospondylus eggshells were extremely thin, measuring less than 0.1 mm.
estimates.quote: The eggshell was extremely thin, less than 0.1 mm, unlike the much thicker eggshells in later dinosaurs

estimates.statement: Mauriciosaurus measured about 2 meters in body length and is notable for its exceptional state of preservation.
estimates.quote: Medía cerca de 2 metros de longitud corporal y su principal atractivo es el gran estado de preservación que posee.

estimates.statement: Based on skull size comparisons, Megacephalosaurus likely had a total body length between 6 and 9 meters.
estimates.quote: This would yield a range of 6-9 m in total body length for Megacephalosaurus.

estimates.statement: Megacephalosaurus had an estimated total length of 6 to 9 meters (20 to 30 feet).
estimates.quote: con una longitud estimada de 6 a 9 metros (20 a 30 pies)

estimates.statement: Based on skull proportions, the total body length of Megacephalosaurus is estimated to be between 6 and 9 meters (20 to 30 feet).
estimates.quote: Esto produciría un largo de 6 a 9 metros (20 a 30 pies) de longitud corporal total para Megacephalosaurus.

estimates.statement: The paratype UNSM 50136 is estimated to have been 175 cm (69 inches) long when complete, making it larger than the holotype.
estimates.quote: UNSM 50136, aunque incompleto, es mucho más grande que FHSM VP-321 y se estima que medía 175 centímetros (69 pulgadas) cuando estaba completo.

estimates.statement: Most recent estimates suggest Megalneusaurus was between 7.6 and 9.2 meters long.
estimates.quote: However, most recent estimates reduce the size of Megalneusaurus to between 7.6 and 9.2 m long.

estimates.statement: In 2024, Ruizhe Jackevan Zhao estimated Megalneusaurus to be approximately 9.8 meters long with a body mass of 12 tons.
estimates.quote: In 2024, Chinese paleontologist Ruizhe Jackevan Zhao suggested that Megalneusaurus would have been similar in size to Pliosaurus funkei, which according to his model was approximately 9.8 m long with a body mass of 12 t.

estimates.statement: Megalolamna could reach a maximum length of 5.1 meters, similar to the modern great white shark.
estimates.quote: Although having a maximum length estimated at 5.1 m, a measurement similar to that of the current great white shark

estimates.statement: Megalosaurus was a bipedal predator approximately 9 meters long and weighing around one tonne, with a body structure balanced for running.
estimates.quote: Megalosaurus fue un depredador bípedo de unos 9 metros de largo y alrededor de una tonelada de peso con una estructura bien balanceada para la carrera.

estimates.statement: Traditionally, most texts following Owen's 1841 estimate state that Megalosaurus had a body length of 9 meters.
estimates.quote: Tradicionalmente, la mayoría de los textos, siguiendo la estimación de Owen de 1841, dan una longitud corporal de 9 metros para Megalosaurus.

estimates.statement: Owen calculated a total body length of 30 feet for Megalosaurus by adding known vertebrae lengths.
estimates.quote: By simply adding the known length of the vertebrae, instead of extrapolating from a lizard, Owen arrived at a total body length for Megalosaurus of 30 feet.

estimates.statement: Megalosaurus was approximately 6 meters long and weighed about 700 kilograms.
estimates.quote: Megalosaurus was about 6 m long, weighing about 700 kg

estimates.statement: In 2010, Gregory S. Paul revised his estimates to suggest Megalosaurus was 6 meters long and weighed 700 kilograms.
estimates.quote: Paul in 2010 estimated the size of Megalosaurus at 6 m in length and 700 kg.

estimates.statement: In 2010, Paul stated that Megalosaurus measured 6 meters in length and weighed 700 kilograms.
estimates.quote: Paul en 2010 declaró Megalosaurus medía 6 metros de largo y 700 kilogramos de peso.

estimates.statement: Buckland's 1824 description estimated Megalosaurus at 40 feet long and weighing as much as a seven-foot-tall elephant.
estimates.quote: In the original description of 1824, Buckland repeated Cuvier's size estimate that Megalosaurus would have been 40 feet long with the weight of a seven foot tall elephant.

estimates.statement: Megaraptor is estimated to have reached a length of 8 meters and a mass of 1 tonne.
estimates.quote: It has been estimated that Megaraptor measured 8 m in length, and weighed around 1 tonnes

estimates.quote: The holotype of Megaraptor was estimated by Fernando Novas to measure around 8 m in length

estimates.statement: Gregory S. Paul estimated Megaraptor's length at 8 meters and weight at 1 tonne in 2010.
estimates.quote: In 2010, Gregory S. Paul estimated its length at 8 m, its weight at 1 tonnes

estimates.statement: Asier Larramendi and Rubén Molina-Pérez estimated Megaraptor's length at 8.3 meters, hip height at 2.35 meters, and mass at 1.3 tonnes in 2016.
estimates.quote: In 2016, extrapolating instead from other megaraptorans, Asier Larramendi and Rubén Molina-Pérez estimated that M. namunhuaiquii had a body length of 8.3 m, a hip height of 2.35 m, and a body mass of 1.3 t

estimates.statement: Megaraptor was a robust carnivorous theropod measuring between 8 and 9 meters in length.
estimates.quote: Megaraptor fue un terópodo carnívoro de entre 8 y 9 metros de largo y de constitución robusta.

estimates.statement: Porfiri and colleagues estimated a mature Megaraptor specimen to be 9–10 meters long in 2014.
estimates.quote: Porfiri and colleagues, in their 2014 paper describing MUCPv 595, estimated the length of a mature specimen at 9–10 m based on the proportions of Allosaurus

estimates.statement: M. inexpectatus has been estimated to reach a length of approximately 2 meters.
estimates.quote: M. inexpectatus for instance has been estimated to have reached a length of approximately 2 m by Balouet

estimates.statement: Mekosuchus species reached a maximum length of 2 meters.
estimates.quote: Las especies de este género eran de pequeñas dimensiones, de 2 metros de longitud máxima

estimates.statement: Holt and colleagues estimate that members of the genus Mekosuchus are around 1 meter in length.
estimates.quote: Holt and colleagues estimate members of Mekosuchus to be around 1 m in length.

estimates.statement: Metriorhynchus averaged about 3 meters in length, similar in size to many modern crocodiles.
estimates.quote: Con cerca de 3 metros de longitud en promedio, Metriorhynchus era de un tamaño similar al de muchos cocodrilos modernos

estimates.statement: Microraptor was one of the smallest non-avian dinosaurs, with the holotype of M. gui measuring 77 cm in length, having a wingspan of 88 to 94 cm, and weighing between 0.5 and 1.4 kg.
estimates.quote: Microraptor was among the smallest-known non-avian dinosaurs, with the holotype of M. gui measuring 77 cm in length, 88 - 94 cm in wingspan and weighing 0.5 - 1.4 kg.

estimates.statement: Adult Microraptor specimens ranged from 42 to 83 centimeters in length, with an average of 77 centimeters and an estimated weight of 1 kilogram.
estimates.quote: Los especímenes adultos de Microraptor rondaban los 42 a 83 centímetros de largo, con un promedio de 77 centímetros, con un peso estimado de 1 kilogramo

estimates.statement: Monoclonius was a dinosaur with a medium-sized horn and measured around 6 meters in length.
estimates.quote: Monoclonius era un dinosaurio con cuerno de mediano tamaño, media alrededor de 6 metros de largo.

estimates.statement: In 2010, Gregory S. Paul estimated the length at 5.5 meters and the weight at 475 kilograms.
estimates.quote: In 2010, Paul estimated the length at 5.5 m and the weight at 475 kg.

estimates.statement: Monolophosaurus was a mid-sized theropod measuring approximately 5 to 5.5 meters in length and weighing 475 kilograms.
estimates.quote: Monolophosaurus was a mid-sized theropod at about 5 - 5.5 m long and weighed 475 kg.

estimates.statement: In 2016, Molina-Pérez and Larramendi estimated Monolophosaurus to be 7.5 meters long and weigh 710 kilograms.
estimates.quote: En 2016, Molina-Pérez y Larramendi dieron una estimación más alta de 7,5 metros y 710 kilogramos.

estimates.statement: Montanoceratops was a small, quadrupedal herbivore that grew up to 2.5 meters in length and weighed 170 kilograms.
estimates.quote: Montanoceratops was a small sized, moderately-built, ground-dwelling, quadrupedal herbivore, that could grow up to an estimated 2.5 m in length and 170 kg in body mass.

estimates.statement: Montanoceratops resembled Protoceratops and measured approximately 3 meters in length.
estimates.quote: Montanoceratops presenta un aspecto similar al de Protoceratops, llegando a medir alrededor de 3 metros de largo.

estimates.statement: The largest species, Mosasaurus hoffmanni, could reach a maximum length of 12 meters.
estimates.quote: The largest species, M. hoffmanni, is estimated to measure up to 12 m in maximum length.

estimates.statement: Muttaburrasaurus was approximately 8 meters long and weighed about 2.8 tons.
estimates.quote: Muttaburrasaurus medía cerca de 8 metros de longitud y pesaba alrededor de 2.8 toneladas.

estimates.statement: Muttaburrasaurus was approximately 8 meters long with initial body mass estimates around 2.8 metric tons.
estimates.quote: Muttaburrasaurus was about 8 m, with initial body mass estimates of around 2.8 MT.

estimates.statement: Mymoorapelta is one of the smaller nodosaurids, with the largest known specimen estimated at 3 meters long.
estimates.quote: Mymoorapelta is one of the smaller known nodosaurids, with the estimated length of the largest specimen only reaching 3 m

estimates.statement: The overall body length was calculated to be about 27.2 meters.
estimates.quote: The overall body length was calculated at about 27.2 m.

estimates.statement: Nannopterygius was a small ichthyosaur that reached a maximum length of 3.5 meters.

estimates.statement: Specimens of Nanosaurus measured between 2 and 2.2 meters in length and weighed between 20 and 30 kilograms.

estimates.statement: Nanotyrannus was a mid-sized tyrannosauroid measuring approximately 17 feet in length.

estimates.quote: Solo medía alrededor de 5,5 metros de longitud y 2 de altura, un tercio del tamaño de Tyrannosaurus.

estimates.statement: Nanshiungosaurus was a large therizinosaurid estimated to reach nearly 5 meters in length and weigh between 600 and 907 kilograms.
estimates.quote: It was a large-sized therizinosaurid that is estimated to have reached nearly 5 m in length and to have weighed about 600 - 907 kg.

estimates.statement: Nanshiungosaurus brevispinus was estimated to be 4.4 to 5 meters long and weigh between 454 and 907 kilograms.
estimates.quote: Nanshiungosaurus brevispinus era un terizinosaurio de cuerpo relativamente grande, estimado en 4,4 a 5 metros de largo con un peso de 454 a 907 kilogramos.

estimates.statement: The species Nanshiungosaurus bohlini was estimated by Paul to be 6 meters long and weigh 1.3 tonnes, distinguished by fused cervical ribs.

estimates.statement: Nanuqsaurus was estimated to be about 6 meters long, roughly half the length of a Tyrannosaurus rex.

estimates.statement: Nasutoceratops is estimated to have reached a body length of 4.5 meters and a weight of 1.5 tonnes.

estimates.statement: The Rodrigues starling measured 25 to 30 cm in length and possessed a stout beak.
estimates.quote: The Rodrigues starling was 25–30 cm long, and had a stout beak.

estimates.statement: The Rodrigues starling measured between 25 and 30 centimeters in length, which was large for a starling.
estimates.quote: The Rodrigues starling was large for a starling, being 25–30 cm in length.

estimates.statement: The bird measured 25–30 cm in length and possessed a long, robust beak.
estimates.quote: El estornino de Rodrigues medía entre 25–30 cm de largo, y tenía un pico largo y robusto.

estimates.statement: Nemegtomaia was estimated to be about 2 meters (7 feet) long and weigh 40 kilograms (85 pounds).
estimates.quote: Nemegtomaia is estimated to have been around 2 m (7 ft) in length, and to have weighed 40 kg (85 lb).

estimates.statement: Nemegtomaia is estimated to have been around 2 meters in length and weighed 40 kilograms.

estimates.statement: The holotype specimen of Noasaurus measures between 1.6 and 2 meters in length.
estimates.quote: Noasaurus was a fairly small theropod, with PVL 4061 measuring somewhere between 1.6–2 m in length.

estimates.statement: Nodocephalosaurus was estimated to be 4.5 meters long and weigh 1.5 tonnes.

estimates.statement: N. graffami weighed around 1 tonne, measured between 4.5 to 6 meters in length, and stood 3 to 3.6 meters tall.

estimates.statement: The holotype specimen of Nyasasaurus indicates a length of 2 to 3 meters.

estimates.statement: The total body length of Nyctosaurus was 37 centimeters.

estimates.statement: The estimated total body length of 4 meters is relatively small for a sauropod.

estimates.statement: A re-evaluation suggests a body length of 6.7 meters and a weight of 1.3 tonnes.

estimates.statement: Omphalosaurus was a moderately large and plump marine reptile reaching 5 meters in length and weighing over 783 kilograms.
estimates.quote: Omphalosaurus is a moderately large and plump marine reptile, measuring 5 m long and weighing more than 783 kg.

estimates.statement: Fully developed Onchopristis could reach a length of about 10 meters.

estimates.statement: Opisthocoelicaudia was a relatively small sauropod measuring between 11.4 and 13 meters in length.

estimates.statement: Gregory S. Paul estimated the length of Ornitholestes at approximately 2.08 meters in 1988.

estimates.statement: Henry Fairfield Osborn originally estimated the length of Ornitholestes at 2.22 meters.

estimates.statement: In 2010, Gregory S. Paul estimated O. edmontonicus to be 3.8 meters long and weigh 170 kilograms.

estimates.statement: Based on a 2002 study, Schupl and colleagues estimated that Prognathodon saturator could reach 12 meters in length.

estimates.statement: The European species P. giganteus had an 85-centimeter skull indicating a length of ten meters, while the larger P. saturator from the Maastrichtian of the Netherlands could reach 14 meters and had very robust jaws with shark bite marks on its skeleton.
estimates.quote: Otra especie europea es P. giganteus, dotada de un cráneo de 85 centímetros de largo que indica una longitud de diez metros, y el aun mayor P. saturator, proveniente del Maastrichtiano de los Países Bajos y que podría llegar incluso a los 14 metros de largo, con un esqueleto que tenía rastros de mordidas de tiburones; sus mandíbulas eran muy robustas.

estimates.statement: P. solvayi is the type species of Prognathodon and is the smallest known species, reaching barely 5 meters in length.
estimates.quote: P. solvayi is the type species of Prognathodon and also the smallest known species at barely 5 meters in length

estimates.statement: It was a medium-sized mosasaurid, about 5 meters long, distinguished by the enlargement of the first two pairs of jaw teeth.
estimates.quote: Era un mosasáurido de tamaño mediano, de unos 5 metros de largo, que se distinguen por el aumento de los dos primeros pares de dientes de la mandíbula.

estimates.statement: The largest known specimen of Prosaurolophus had a skull 0.9 meters long, a body length of 8.5 meters, and a mass of 3 metric tons.
estimates.quote: Prosaurolophus was a large-headed duckbill; the most complete described specimen has a skull around 0.9 m long with its body size measuring 8.5 m in length and 3 MT in body mass.

estimates.statement: The most complete described specimen of Prosaurolophus had a skull approximately 90 centimeters long and a total body length of 8.5 meters.
estimates.quote: el ejemplar más completo descripto tenía un cráneo de alrededor de 90 centímetros y un largo total del cuerpo de 8,5 metros.

estimates.statement: Remains suggest the animal reached a length of around 9 meters.
estimates.quote: Los restos indicarían que alcanzaba alrededor de 9 metros de largo

estimates.statement: Protoceratops could reach a length of 1.8 meters, a height of 60 centimeters at the hips, and weigh 60 kilograms.
estimates.quote: El Protoceratops llegó a medir 1,8 metros de largo, con 60 centímetros de alto hasta la cruz, y a pesar 60 kilogramos.

estimates.statement: Protoceratops species were small ceratopsians, measuring between 2 and 2.5 meters in length and weighing between 62 and 104 kilograms.
estimates.quote: Protoceratops was a relatively small-sized ceratopsian, with both P. andrewsi and P. hellenikorhinus estimated up to 2 - 2.5 m in length, and around 62 - 104 kg in body mass.

estimates.statement: Protoceratops was an herbivore about the size of a sheep, measuring between 1.5 and 2 meters in length, and was very abundant in what is now Mongolia.
estimates.quote: Con el tamaño de una oveja, entre 1,5 a 2 metros, este herbívoro fue muy abundante en lo que es hoy Mongolia.

estimates.statement: Adult Protoceratops were small ceratopsians reaching up to 2.5 meters in length and weighing between 62 and 104 kilograms.
estimates.quote: Protoceratops were small ceratopsians, up to 2 - 2.5 m long and around 62 - 104 kg in body mass

estimates.statement: Psittacosaurus individuals ranged from hatchlings under 13 cm long to adults nearly 2 meters long.
estimates.quote: Individuals of all ages are known, from hatchlings less than 13 cm long, to very old adults reaching nearly 2 m in length.

estimates.statement: Psittacosaurus mongoliensis, the best-known species, could reach up to 2 meters in length.
estimates.quote: La especie de la que se dispone un mayor número de datos e información, Psittacosaurus mongoliensis, podía alcanzar hasta 2 metros de longitud

estimates.statement: An adult Psittacosaurus mongoliensis reached approximately 2 meters in length.
estimates.quote: Un adulto de Psittacosaurus mongoliensis habría alcanzado aproximadamente los 2 metros de largo.

estimates.statement: The best-known species, P. mongoliensis, could reach a length of 2 meters (6.5 feet).
estimates.quote: The best-known—P. mongoliensis—can reach 2 metres (6.5 ft) in length.

estimates.statement: A large male specimen (USNM 50130) had an estimated wingspan of 6.25 to 6.5 meters, a body length of 2.6 meters, and a mass of 50 kg.
estimates.quote: A large specimen of Pteranodon longiceps, USNM 50130, is estimated to have a wingspan of 6.25 - 6.5 m, body length of 2.6 m and body mass of 50 kg.

estimates.statement: Current estimates suggest Puertasaurus was about 30 meters long and 50 metric tons in mass.
estimates.quote: current estimates place it around 30 m long and 50 MT in mass

estimates.statement: Gregory S. Paul estimates a length of 30 meters and a weight of 50 tons in his reconstruction.
estimates.quote: Gregory S. Paul en su reconstrucción estima a Puertasaurus con una longitud de 30 metros y un peso de 50 toneladas.

estimates.statement: Scott Hartman estimates a length of 27 meters and a weight of 60 to 70 tons, using the close relative Futalognkosaurus to fill anatomical gaps.
estimates.quote: Scott Hartman, quien en su restauración esquelética de Puertasaurus, utiliza principalmente al pariente cercano Futalognkosaurus para llenar los vacíos anatómicos, estimando al fragmentario taxón con una longitud de 27 m y sugiriendo un peso 60 a 70 toneladas.

estimates.statement: Fernando Novas estimated the species measured approximately 35 to 40 meters long and weighed between 80 and 100 metric tons.
estimates.quote: Novas estimó que la nueva especie medía aproximadamente de 35 a 40 metros de largo y pesaba entre 80 y 100 toneladas métricas.

estimates.statement: A 2022 study estimated P. brasiliensis lengths between 7.6-10 meters and masses between 2-6.3 metric tonnes depending on the method used.
estimates.quote: A 2022 study also suggested a smaller size estimate, with an estimated length of 7.6 - 9.3 m and mass of 2 - 6.3 MT using a phylogenetic approach, and an estimated length of 9.3 - 10 m and mass of 3.95 - 5 MT using a non-phylogenetic approach.

estimates.statement: P. mirandai would measure around 10 meters in length.
estimates.quote: que mediría alrededor de 10 metros de largo

estimates.statement: P. neivensis has been estimated to be 6.5 to 9 meters long and weigh 2 tonnes.
estimates.quote: P. neivensis size has been estimated at 6.5-9 m (21-30 ft) in length and 2 tonnes in weight.

estimates.statement: Some paleontologists estimate the full body length of P. brasiliensis was between 11 and 13 meters, making Purussaurus one of the largest known crocodiles.
estimates.quote: El cráneo de la especie tipo, P. brasiliensis tiene una longitud máxima de 1,4 metros, por lo que algunos paleontólogos estiman que el cuerpo entero debió medir entre 11 y 13 m, aunque podía ser incluso mayor, convirtiendo al Purussaurus en uno de los mayores cocodrilos que se conozcan.

estimates.statement: Rubén Molina-Pérez and Asier Larramendi estimated Qiupalong's length at 2.85 m and its mass at 63 kg.
estimates.quote: They did not give an estimate for the animal's overall size, but Rubén Molina-Pérez and Asier Larramendi suggested a length of 2.85 m and a mass of 63 kg.

estimates.statement: In 2016, Quilmesaurus was estimated to be 5.3 meters in length.
estimates.quote: In 2016, Quilmesaurus was estimated to have measured 5.3 m in length.

estimates.statement: A 2016 estimate suggested Quilmesaurus measured 5.3 meters in length.
estimates.quote: En 2016, se estimó que Quilmesaurus medía 5,3 metros de longitud

estimates.statement: Quilmesaurus measured approximately 4.6 meters in length and weighed about 430 kg.
estimates.quote: Medía 4,6 m de largo y pesaba 430 kg aproximadamente

estimates.statement: Quinkana is typically estimated to be around 3 meters long and weigh around 200 kilograms.
estimates.quote: Quinkana is typically estimated to be around 3 m in length and to weigh around 200 kg

estimates.statement: The oldest species, Q. meboldi and Q. timara, were small, reaching a length of about 2 meters.
estimates.quote: Las especies más antiguas (Q. meboldi y Q. timara) eran de pequeño tamaño, con cerca de 2 metros de largo

estimates.statement: Quinkana fortirostrum is estimated to have exceeded 5 meters in length, making it one of the largest predators of its time in Australia, surpassed only in size by the giant monitor Megalania.
estimates.quote: Se ha estimado que Quinkana fortirostrum pudo sobrepasar los 5 metros de longitud, convirtiéndolo en uno de los mayores depredadores de la Australia de esa época, solo sobrepasado en tamaño por el varano gigante, Megalania (Varanus priscus)

estimates.statement: Rahiolisaurus was initially estimated at 8 meters long and 2 metric tons, but later allometric estimates suggest a length of 6.22 to 6.75 meters.
estimates.quote: Rahiolisaurus was initially described as a large-sized abelisaurid and around 8 m long and weighing 2 MT, but the allometry-based estimate for different specimens suggest a shorter body length of 6.22 - 6.75 m.

estimates.statement: Rajasaurus is estimated to have measured approximately 6.6 meters in length.

estimates.statement: A 2016 study revised the estimated length of Rajasaurus to 6.6 meters.
estimates.quote: In 2016, its length was estimated to be 6.6 m

estimates.statement: In 2016, an estimate placed Rajasaurus's length at 6.6 meters.
estimates.quote: En 2016, se estimó que su longitud era de 6,6 metros.

estimates.statement: Rajasaurus was a robust predatory dinosaur measuring 6 to 7 meters in length and 2.4 meters in height, with an estimated weight of 400 to 700 kilograms.
estimates.quote: Rajasaurus era un robusto dinosaurio depredador de entre 6 a 7 metros de largo y 2,4 de alto, con un peso estimado que rondaría las 400 a 700 kilos.

estimates.statement: In 2010, Gregory S. Paul estimated Rajasaurus to be 11 meters long and weigh 4 metric tons.
estimates.quote: In 2010, palaeontologist Gregory S. Paul estimated the body length of Rajasaurus at 11 m and weight at 4 MT

estimates.statement: In 2010, paleontologist Gregory S. Paul estimated Rajasaurus's body length at 11 meters and its weight at 4 tons.
estimates.quote: En 2010, el paleontólogo Gregory S. Paul estimó la longitud corporal de Rajasaurus en 11 metros y el peso en 4 toneladas.

estimates.statement: At 7 meters long, Razanandrongobe was the largest known member of the Notosuchia and likely occupied a predatory niche similar to theropod dinosaurs.
estimates.quote: Measuring 7 m long, it was the largest member of the Notosuchia and may have occupied a predatory ecological niche similar to theropods.

estimates.statement: Researchers inferred that Razanandrongobe had a body shape similar to Baurusuchidae, measuring 7 meters long, 1.6 meters high at the hip, and weighing 800 to 1000 kilograms.
estimates.quote: Dal Sasso and colleagues inferred a body shape similar to the Baurusuchidae, producing an overall length of 7 m, a height at the hip of 1.6 m, and a weight of 800 - 1000 kg.

estimates.statement: At 7 meters in length, Razanandrongobe is the largest known member of Notosuchia.
estimates.quote: Con 7 metros de longitud, es el mayor miembro de Notosuchia

estimates.statement: Researchers inferred a total length of 7 meters, a hip height of 1.6 meters, and a weight of 800 to 1000 kilograms based on comparisons with baurusuchids.
estimates.quote: Dal Sasso y colaboradores infirieron que tenía una forma corporal similar a la de los baurusúquidos, produciendo una longitud total de 7 metros, una altura a la cadera de 1.6 metros, y un peso de 800 - 1000 kilogramos.

estimates.statement: Recent estimates suggest Rebbachisaurus was about 14 meters long and weighed between 7 and 12 metric tons.
estimates.quote: Although once thought to be as long as 20 m in length, more recent estimates place it at 14 m long and weighing 7 - 12 MT.

estimates.statement: Recent studies estimate Rebbachisaurus was approximately 14 meters long and weighed between 7 and 12 metric tons.
estimates.quote: Recent studies state that Rebbachisaurus was around 14 m long and weighed 7 - 12 MT.

estimates.statement: In 2010, Gregory S. Paul estimated Rebbachisaurus to be 14 meters long and weigh 7 tons.
estimates.quote: En 2010, Gregory S. Paul estimó Rebbachisaurus en 14 metros y 7 toneladas

estimates.statement: Holtz estimated a greater length of 20 meters.
estimates.quote: Holtz dio una longitud mayor de 20 metros

estimates.statement: In 2020, Molina-Pérez and Larramendi estimated a length of 26 meters and a weight of 40 tons.
estimates.quote: En 2020, Molina-Pérez y Larramendi dieron una estimación mayor de 26 metrosy 40 toneladas

estimates.statement: The largest known specimen of Rhamphorhynchus muensteri measures 1.26 meters in length with a wingspan of 1.81 meters.
estimates.quote: El mayor ejemplar conocido de Rhamphorhynchus muensteri (número de catálogo BMNH 37002) mide 1.26 metros de largo con una envergadura de 1.81 metros.

estimates.statement: R. crassidens could reach body lengths of 8 to 11 meters based on rigorous estimates of known specimens.
estimates.quote: Both species are known for their great size, with rigorous estimates showing potential body lengths ranging from 8 to 11 m based on all known specimens for R. crassidens

estimates.statement: Researcher Jason Head estimated the total length of Rhamphosuchus to be between 8 and 11 meters based on known specimens.
estimates.quote: Jason Head's research, who estimated a total length of around 8 to 11 m based on all known specimens

estimates.statement: However, a more recent study suggests the animal measured 8 to 11 meters in length, and therefore is not the largest known crocodilian.
estimates.quote: Sin embargo, un estudio más reciente sugiere que el animal debió de medir 8-11metros de largo, y por lo tanto no es el mayor crocodiliano conocido.

estimates.statement: A 2025 estimate suggests R. pachyrhynchus reached body lengths of 6 to 8 meters.
estimates.quote: to a 2025 estimate for R. pachyrhynchus around 6 to 8 m.

estimates.statement: In 2025, Courville and colleagues estimated Rhamphosuchus pachyrhynchus reached a length of 6 to 8 meters after moving it to the genus Rhamphosuchus.
estimates.quote: Courville and colleagues, who moved the species to the genus Rhamphosuchus in 2025, provided a more modest estimate for this species, suggesting it might have reached a length between 6 to 8 m.

estimates.statement: Traditionally, many paleontologists estimated that Rhamphosuchus was one of the largest, if not the largest, crocodilians to have lived, reaching an estimated length of 15 to 18 meters.
estimates.quote: Tradicionalmente, muchos paleontólogos estimaron que fue uno de los mayores, si no el más grande crocodiliano que haya vivido, alcanzando una longitud estimada de entre 15 a 18metros.

estimates.statement: Early researcher Richard Lydekker estimated Rhamphosuchus crassidens reached a length of 15 to 18 meters.
estimates.quote: Lydekker estimating its length to have been somewhere between 15 to 18 m based on the proportions of modern gharials.

estimates.statement: The largest known Romerodus reached approximately 50 cm in total length.
estimates.quote: the largest known Romerodus were approximately 50 cm in total length

estimates.statement: The maximum stated total length of R. orodontus is approximately 50 cm (20 inches).
estimates.quote: The maximum total length of R. orodontus is stated to be approximately 50 cm (20 in) in its description

estimates.statement: Comparisons with the related genus Caririsuchus suggest Roxochampsa reached an approximate total body size of 1 to 2 meters.
estimates.quote: Comparing the mandibular length estimate with the proportions of the much more complete Caririsuchus yields an approximate size of 1-2 m

estimates.statement: Rugops had an estimated length of 4.4 to 5.3 meters and a weight of 410 kilograms.
estimates.quote: Rugops has an estimated length of 4.4 - 5.3 m and weight of 410 kg

estimates.statement: Later estimates revised the length of Rugops to 4.4 meters.
estimates.quote: Estimaciones posteriores sugieren una longitud revisada de 4,4 metros.

estimates.statement: Other authors suggest Rugops measured 5.3 meters in length and weighed 410 kilograms.
estimates.quote: Al mismo tiempo, otros autores sugieren que medía 5,3 metros de largo y 410 kilogramos de peso.

estimates.statement: Rugops is known from a partial skull found in the Echkar Formation and a left maxilla from the Kem Kem Beds, with an initial estimated length of 6 meters and weight of 750 kilograms.
estimates.quote: Aunque se conoce solo por un cráneo parcial encontrado en la Formación Echkar y un maxilar izquierdo de los Lechos de Kem Kem, se estimó inicialmente que Rugops tenía 6 metros de largo y 750 kilogramos de peso según las comparaciones con sus parientes.

estimates.statement: Rutiodon was one of the largest carnivores of its time, reaching lengths of up to 8 meters and weighing about 1 metric ton.
estimates.quote: Rutiodon was among the largest carnivorous animals of its environment, measuring up to 8 m long and weighing about 1 MT.

estimates.statement: Rutiodon, meaning "wrinkle tooth," was an extinct archosaurian saurian of the order Phytosauria that lived during the Triassic period and reached up to 8 meters in length.
estimates.quote: Rutiodon ("diente arrugado") es un género extinto de saurópsidos arcosaurios del orden fitosaurios, que vivió en el periodo Triásico, y llegaba a medir hasta 8 metros de largo.

estimates.statement: Saichania was more robust than other ankylosaurids, reaching lengths of 5 to 7 meters and weighing between 1.4 and 2.0 metric tons.
estimates.quote: Saichania is more robustly built than other members of the Ankylosauridae, measuring 5 - 7 m in length and 1.4 - 2.0 MT in body mass.

estimates.statement: Saichania is classified as a medium-sized ankylosaur with a length of 5 to 7 meters and a mass of 1.4 to 2.0 metric tons.
estimates.quote: Saichania was a medium-sized ankylosaur, measuring 5 - 7 m in length and 1.4 - 2.0 MT in body mass.

estimates.statement: Other estimates confirmed a maximum length of approximately 6.6 meters.
estimates.quote: Otras estimaciones confirmaron aproximadamente esto, indicando una longitud máxima de aproximadamente 6,6 metros de largo.

estimates.statement: Gregory S. Paul estimated in 2010 that Saichania was 5.2 meters long and weighed two tons.
estimates.quote: Gregory S. Paul en 2010 dio una estimación más baja de 5,2 metros, con un peso de dos toneladas.
estimates.source_title: Saichania chulsanensis (Tamaño, constitución y rasgos distintivos)

estimates.statement: Saichania measured over 5 meters in length and weighed over two tonnes.
estimates.quote: Saichania medía más de 5 metros de largo y pesaba más de dos toneladas.

estimates.statement: Saichania could reach 7 meters in length and 2.2 meters in height, with an estimated weight of 2 tonnes.
estimates.quote: Saichania era un poderoso dinosaurio acorazado que llegó a medir 7 metros de largo y 2,2 de alto, con un peso estimado de 2 toneladas.

estimates.statement: Maryańska estimated the length of Saichania at 7 meters.
estimates.quote: Maryańska estimó su longitud en 7 metros.
estimates.source_title: Saichania chulsanensis (Tamaño, constitución y rasgos distintivos)

estimates.statement: Sarahsaurus was mid-sized for a basal sauropodomorph, with a vertebral column measuring more than 3.1 meters in length.
estimates.quote: Sarahsaurus was mid-sized for a basal sauropodomorph, with its vertebral column measuring more than 3.1 m in length.

estimates.statement: Paleontologist Gregory Paul estimated Sarahsaurus to be 4 meters long and weigh 200 kilograms.
estimates.quote: Paleontologist Gregory Paul, in a 2016 popular book, estimated its length at 4 m and its body weight at 200 kg.

estimates.statement: A referred specimen, NHMUK PV R3542, belonged to a larger individual estimated to reach 5 meters in length and weigh 140 kilograms.
estimates.quote: NHMUK PV R3542 belonged to a larger animal, estimated to have had a maximum length of 5 m and a weight of 140 kg.

estimates.statement: Specimen NHMUK PV R3542 belonged to a larger animal estimated to have a maximum length of 5 meters and a weight of 140 kilograms.

estimates.statement: The holotype belonged to an animal 3.5 meters long with a weight not exceeding 50-60 kilograms.
estimates.quote: El holotipo pertenecía a un animal de 3,5 metros de largo cuyo peso no superaba los 50-60 kilogramos

estimates.statement: Fully grown S. imperator individuals are estimated to have reached lengths of 9 to 9.5 meters and weights of 3.45 to 4.3 metric tons.
estimates.quote: S. imperator is one of the biggest crocodylomorphs known, with fully grown individuals estimated to have reached up to 9 to 9.5 m in total length and 3.45 to 4.3 MT in weight.

estimates.statement: The largest known skull of S. imperator measures 1.6 meters in length, leading to an estimated total body length of 11.65 meters.
estimates.quote: The largest known skull of S. imperator (the type specimen) is 1.6 m long (1.5 m in the midline), and it was estimated that the individual it belonged to had a total body length of 11.65 m.

estimates.statement: O'Brien et al. (2019) estimated the largest S. imperator specimen was nearly 9 meters long and weighed 3.45 metric tons.
estimates.quote: O'Brien et al. (2019) estimated the length of the largest S. imperator specimen at nearly 9 m and body mass at 3.45 MT based on longirostrine crocodylian skull width to total length and body width ratio.

estimates.statement: Sarcosuchus measured nearly 12 meters in length, had scales up to 30 cm long, weighed around 8,000 kg, and had a mandible measuring 1.80 meters long.
estimates.quote: Medía cerca de 12 metros de largo, tenía escamas de 30 cm de largo, pesaba alrededor de 8.000 kilos y su mandíbula medía 1,80 metros de largo.

estimates.statement: Saurichthys was an elongate, streamlined fish that typically measured between 0.6 and 1 meter in length.
estimates.quote: Saurichthys was an elongate, streamlined fish, commonly about 0.6 m to 1 m long.

estimates.statement: While some species were only a few decimeters long, others could reach approximately 1.5 meters in length, such as a specimen from the Middle Triassic of Turkey.
estimates.quote: Some species were only a few decimetres long (e.g. Saurichthys minimahleri), while others could grow up to about 1.5 m in length (specimen from the Middle Triassic of Turkey).

estimates.statement: S. angustirostris is estimated to have been 12 to 13 meters long and weighed up to 11 tonnes.
estimates.quote: The larger Mongolian species S. angustirostris has had its size estimated from 12 m (39 ft) to 13 m long and weighed up to 11 tonne.

estimates.statement: S. osborni was approximately 8.2 to 8.5 meters long with a skull measuring 1.0 meter.
estimates.quote: S. osborni, the rarer Albertan species, was around 8.2 - 8.5 m long, with its skull 1.0 m long.

estimates.statement: S. osborni was estimated to be about 8.2 meters long with a 1-meter skull and a weight of 1.9 tons.

estimates.statement: S. angustirostris was larger, measuring about 13 meters long, though larger specimens have been reported.
estimates.quote: El S. angustirostris, la especie de Mongolia , era más grande medía aproximadamente 13 metros de largo aunque ejemplares más grandes se han reportado.

estimates.statement: Sauropelta was a medium-sized dinosaur measuring between 5.2 and 6 meters in length.
estimates.quote: Sauropelta is a medium-sized nodosaurid, measuring about 5.2 - 6 m long.

estimates.statement: Sauropelta was a heavily built quadrupedal herbivore approximately 5.2 meters long and weighing 1.5 tons.
estimates.quote: Sauropelta fue un cuadrúpedo herbívoro pesadamente construido con un cuerpo de aproximadamente 5,2 metros de largo y un peso de 1,5 toneladas.

estimates.statement: Sauropelta was a medium-sized nodosaurid measuring about 5 meters in length.
estimates.quote: Era un nodosáurido de tamaño mediano, midiendo cerca de 5 metros de largo.

estimates.statement: Gregory S. Paul estimated the length at 6 meters and weight at 2 tons, while Thomas Holtz gave a higher estimate of 7.6 meters.
estimates.quote: Gregory S. Paul lo estimó en 6 metros y 2 toneladas. Thomas Holtz dio una estimación más alta de 7,6 metros.

estimates.statement: Estimates suggest the animal reached lengths of 27 to 34 meters and masses of 40 to 60 metric tons.
