estimates.statement: Estimates of its total body length range from 27 to 34 meters.
estimates.quote: Estimates of its total possible length have ranged from 27 m to 34 m.

estimates.statement: Estimates for Sauroposeidon's total possible length have ranged between 27 and 34 meters.
estimates.quote: Las estimaciones de su longitud total posible han oscilado entre 27 metros y 34 metros.

estimates.statement: Sauroposeidon had an estimated length of up to 27 meters and a mass between 36 and 40 tonnes.
estimates.quote: Con una longitud estimada de hasta 27 metros y una masa de entre 36 a 40 toneladas.

estimates.statement: The type species Saurornitholestes langstoni measured between 1.3 and 1.8 meters long and weighed between 5 and 22.5 kilograms.
estimates.quote: Saurornitholestes was a small dromaeosaur, with the type species S. langstoni measuring about 1.3 - 1.8 m long and weighing approximately between 5 and 22.5 kg.

estimates.statement: Saurornitholestes measured approximately 1.8 meters in length and weighed about 10 kilograms.
estimates.quote: Medía aproximadamente 1,8 metros de largo de longitud y de 10 kilogramos de peso.

estimates.statement: Adult Saurosuchus measured between 5.5 and 7 meters in length and weighed up to 590 kilograms.
estimates.quote: Saurosuchus is estimated to have measured 5.5 - 7 m in length and to have weighed up to 590 kg

estimates.statement: Adult Saurosuchus adults measured 5.5 to 7 meters long and weighed approximately 590 kg.
estimates.quote: Adults measured between 5.5 - 7 m in length, and are estimated to have weighed 590 kg.

estimates.statement: Saurosuchus was likely the largest member of its group, measuring about 7 meters in length, with the possible exception of the less known Fasolasuchus.
estimates.quote: Con una longitud de 7 metros, seguramente fue el mayor miembro de su grupo, con la excepción quizás del menos conocido Fasolasuchus.

estimates.statement: Savannasaurus was a medium-sized titanosaur measuring about 15 meters in length.
estimates.quote: At 15 m long, Savannasaurus was a medium-sized titanosaur.

estimates.statement: Savannasaurus was a medium-sized sauropod dinosaur reaching approximately 15 meters in length.
estimates.quote: Savannasaurus es un titanosaurio de tamaño mediano, con cerca de 15 metros de longitud.

estimates.statement: Scanisaurus was about 4 to 5 meters long and likely fed on small prey like fish or belemnites in both open water and on the sea floor.
estimates.quote: Scanisaurus shared its environment with a diverse marine fauna, including many other marine reptiles. It would have been a middle trophic-level predator, about 4 – 5 m in length, and would have been able to feed both in open water and on the sea floor, likely feeding mainly on small prey such as small fish or belemnites.

estimates.statement: Scanisaurus was about 4-5 meters (13-16 feet) long, likely a middle trophic-level predator that fed in open water and on the sea floor, probably eating small prey like small fish or belemnites.
estimates.quote: Scanisaurus compartió su entorno con una fauna marina diversa, incluyendo muchos otros reptiles marinos. Habría sido un depredador de nivel trófico intermedio, de unos 4-5 metros (13-16 pies) de longitud, y habría sido capaz de alimentarse tanto en aguas abiertas como en el fondo marino, probablemente alimentándose principalmente de presas pequeñas como peces pequeños o belemnites.

estimates.statement: Based on fossil size and comparisons with other plesiosaurs, Scanisaurus likely reached 4 to 5 meters (13 to 16 feet) in length.
estimates.quote: Basado en el tamaño de sus fósiles y comparaciones con las proporciones de otros plesiosaurios, Scanisaurus probablemente alcanzaba 4-5 metros (13-16 pies) de longitud.

estimates.statement: Scelidosaurus was approximately 4 meters long.
estimates.quote: Scelidosaurus was about 4 m long.

estimates.statement: Gregory S. Paul estimated Scelidosaurus weighed 270 kg and measured 3.8 meters in length in 2010.
estimates.quote: In 2010, Gregory S. Paul gave a body length of 3.8 metres (12.5 ft) and a weight of 270 kg.

estimates.statement: Scelidosaurus was a lightly armored, quadrupedal herbivore reaching about 4 meters in length.
estimates.quote: Era un herbívoro cuadrúpedo, ligeramente acorazado que alcanzaba los 4 metros de largo.

estimates.statement: Gregory S. Paul estimated Scelidosaurus to be 3.8 meters long and weigh 270 kilograms in 2010.
estimates.quote: En 2010, Gregory S. Paul dio una longitud corporal de 3,8 metros (12,5 pies) y un peso de 270 kilogramos.

estimates.statement: The juvenile specimen measured 23 cm in length and 15 cm in height, leading to an estimate that an adult reached 2 meters in length, 0.70 meters in height, and weighed 20 kilograms.
estimates.quote: El ejemplar medía 23 centímetros de largo y 15 de alto, por lo que se estima que un adulto llegó a los 2 metros de largo, 0,70 de alto y a pesar 20 kilogramos.

estimates.statement: The type species Scolosaurus cutleri grew up to 5.6 meters long and weighed 2.2 metric tons.
estimates.quote: The type species, S. cutleri, measured up to 5.6 m in length and 2.2 MT in body mass.

estimates.statement: Scolosaurus was a medium-sized ankylosaur with a body length of about 6 meters and a weight of about 2 tons.
estimates.quote: Scolosaurus es un anquilosaurio de tamaño mediano con una longitud corporal de unos 6 metros y un peso de unas 2 toneladas.

estimates.statement: The specimen MPEF-PV 1776 is estimated to have been between 2.2 and 3.1 meters long and weighed between 52.2 and 113.5 kilograms.
estimates.quote: Estimates of total body length and mass of MPEF-PV 1776 vary from 2.2 to 3.1 m, and from 52.2 to 113.5 kg, respectively.

estimates.statement: Postcranial remains suggest Sebecus had a total body length of 2.2 to 3.1 meters and weighed between 52.2 and 113.5 kilograms.
estimates.quote: Les permiten inferir una longitud corporal total de 2.2 a 3.1 metros y un peso de 52.2 a 113.5 kilogramos.

estimates.statement: Segnosaurus was estimated to be about 6 to 7 meters long and weigh approximately 1.3 metric tons.
estimates.quote: Segnosaurus was a large-bodied therizinosaur that is estimated to have been about 6–7 m long and to have weighed about 1.3 MT.

estimates.statement: Segnosaurus is estimated to have been between 6 and 7 meters long and weighed around 1.3 tons.
estimates.quote: Segnosaurus era un terizinosaurio de gran tamaño que se estima que medía entre 6 y 7 metros de largo y pesaba alrededor de 1,3 toneladas.

estimates.statement: Adult Simosuchus measured approximately 0.75 meters in length.
estimates.quote: Fully grown individuals were about 0.75 m in length.

estimates.statement: Based on mature skeletons, Simosuchus was small, measuring about 75 centimeters in length.
estimates.quote: Simosuchus era pequeño, de cerca de 75 centímetros de longitud basándose en los esqueletos de los individuos maduros

estimates.statement: Adult individuals of Simosuchus would have measured approximately 1 meter in length.
estimates.quote: Los individuos adultos habrían medido 1 metro en longitud, aproximadamente

estimates.statement: The holotype of Sinornithosaurus measured 1.2 meters long and weighed between 3 and 5 kilograms.
estimates.quote: Sinornithosaurus was among the smallest dromaeosaurids, with the holotype measuring 1.2 m long and weighing 3 - 5 kg.

estimates.statement: Sinornithosaurus was among the smallest dromaeosaurids, with a length of about 90 centimeters.
estimates.quote: Sinornithosaurus estaba entre los dromeosáuridos más pequeños, con una longitud de unos 90 centímetros.

estimates.statement: The holotype specimen of Sinosauropteryx measured 68 cm in length, including the tail, making it one of the smallest known adult non-avian theropods.
estimates.quote: The taxon includes some of the smallest known adult non-avian theropod specimens, with the holotype specimen measuring only 68 cm in length, including the tail

estimates.statement: The largest known specimen of Sinosauropteryx reached a length of 1.07 meters and an estimated weight of 0.55 kilograms.
estimates.quote: The longest known specimen reaches up to 1.07 m in length, with an estimated weight of 0.55 kg.

estimates.statement: Sinosaurus was a medium-sized basal theropod reaching about 5.5 meters in length, 1.8 meters at the hip, and weighing 450 kilograms.
estimates.quote: Sinosaurus fue un terópodo basal de tamaño medio, llegó a medir alrededor de 5,5 metros de largo, 1,8 metros a la cadera y pesar 450 kilogramos.

estimates.statement: The animal measured approximately 5.6 meters in length.
estimates.quote: El animal medía unos 5,6 metros de largo.

estimates.statement: Based on the anatomy of related species, Skorpiovenator is estimated to have reached a length of 6 to 6.2 meters and a weight of slightly under 900 kilograms.
estimates.quote: Based on the anatomy of close relatives, it may have been between 6 - 6.2 m long in life, and may have weighed a little under 900 kg.

estimates.statement: Because most of the tail is missing, the maximum estimated length is 6 to 6.2 meters and the maximum estimated weight is 891 kilograms.
estimates.quote: Since it lacks most of the tail, precise length measurements are currently impossible, but it has been estimated to have grown up to 6 - 6.2 m long and weighed up to 891 kg.

estimates.statement: Based on a preserved skeleton length of 4.37 meters, Skorpiovenator is estimated to have reached about 6 meters in total length.
estimates.quote: Se estima que el Skorpiovenator llegaba a medir unos 6 m de longitud, con base en su esqueleto con una longitud preservada de 4,37 m.

estimates.statement: Soroavisaurus is estimated to have been about 40 cm long, though size variation suggests some individuals were larger.
estimates.quote: The body length of Soroavisaurus has been estimated at about 40 cm, but the disparity in size among known specimens suggests that some individuals grew larger than others.

estimates.statement: The holotype specimen was about 13 meters long along the spine, while the paratype was about 13 percent larger at 14 meters.
estimates.quote: El espécimen holotipo tenía alrededor de 13 metros de largo cuando se mide a lo largo de la columna vertebral, mientras que el paratipo era aproximadamente un 13 por ciento más grande, midiendo alrededor de 14 metros.

estimates.statement: A 2022 study estimates that Spinosaurus aegyptiacus could have reached a length of 14 meters and a mass of 7.4 metric tons.
estimates.quote: A 2022 study suggests that S. aegyptiacus could have reached 14 m in length and 7.4 MT in body mass

estimates.statement: In 2022, Paul Sereno and colleagues suggested Spinosaurus aegyptiacus reached a maximum length of 14 meters and mass of 7.4 metric tons using a CT-based 3D skeletal model.
estimates.quote: In 2022, however, Paul Sereno and his colleagues suggested that Spinosaurus aegyptiacus reached a maximum body length of 14 m and a maximum body mass of 7.4 MT by constructing a CT-based 3D skeletal model "with the axial column in neutral pose."

estimates.statement: A 2022 study suggests S. aegyptiacus could have reached 14 meters (46 feet) in length and 7.4 tonnes (8.2 short tons) in body mass.
estimates.quote: Un estudio de 2022 sugiere que S. aegyptiacus podría haber alcanzado los 14 m (46 pies) de longitud y 7,4 t (8,2 toneladas cortas) de masa corporal

estimates.statement: Based on skull lengths of 1.5 to 1.75 meters, Therrien and Henderson estimated Spinosaurus body length at 12.6 to 14.3 meters and mass at 12 to 20.9 metric tons.
estimates.quote: Based on estimated skull lengths of 1.5 to 1.75 m, they estimated a body length of 12.6 to 14.3 m and a body mass of 12 to 20.9 MT; they also suggested that contrary to Dal Sasso et al. (2005), their scaling based on a 11 m long Suchomimus would produce an estimated body mass of 11.7 to 16.7 MT.

estimates.statement: Friedrich von Huene in 1926 and Donald F. Glut in 1982 listed Spinosaurus as among the most massive theropods, estimating it at 15 meters in length and over 6 metric tons in weight.
estimates.quote: Both Friedrich von Huene in 1926 and Donald F. Glut in 1982 listed it as among the most massive theropods in their surveys, at 15 m in length and upwards of 6 MT in weight.

estimates.statement: In 2005, Dal Sasso and colleagues estimated Spinosaurus was 16 to 18 meters long and weighed 7 to 9 metric tons based on body proportions similar to Suchomimus.
estimates.quote: In 2005, Dal Sasso and colleagues assumed that Spinosaurus and the related Suchomimus had the same body proportions in relation to their skull lengths, and estimated that Spinosaurus was 16 to 18 m long and weighed 7 to 9 MT.

estimates.statement: The holotype, a subadult individual, is estimated to have reached a full body length of around 8 meters.
estimates.quote: The holotype specimen, which belongs to a subadult individual, was estimated to have a full body length of around 8 m.

estimates.statement: According to Sereno et al. (2026), the holotype specimen of Spinosaurus mirabilis has a total body length of 8 meters.
estimates.quote: En el trabajo de Sereno Et al. (2026) mencionan en su diagrama esquelético de Spinosaurus mirabilis que su longitud corporal para el ejemplar holotipo es de 8 metros en total

estimates.statement: Researchers suggest a hypothetical fully mature individual could have reached 10 to 14 meters in length.
estimates.quote: En el trabajo sugieren que un individuo completamente maduro hipotético podría haber alcanzado a los 10 - 14 metros de largo

estimates.statement: The length of Staurikosaurus is measured at 2.2 to 2.25 meters.
estimates.quote: Its length is measured at 2.2 - 2.25 m long

estimates.statement: Staurikosaurus measured 2.25 meters in length, 80 centimeters in height, and weighed 30 kilograms.
estimates.quote: Con 2,25 metros de largo, 80 centímetros de alto y un peso de 30 kilogramos

estimates.statement: Gregory S. Paul estimated the length of Staurikosaurus at 2.1 meters and its body mass at 12 kilograms.
estimates.quote: Gregory S. Paul presented a lower length estimate of 2.1 m and a body mass estimate of 12 kg.

estimates.statement: Stegoceras was a small, bipedal dinosaur measuring 2 to 2.5 meters in length and weighing between 10 and 40 kilograms.
estimates.quote: Stegoceras was a small, bipedal dinosaur about 2 to 2.5 m long, and weighed around 10 to 40 kg.

estimates.statement: Stegoceras was estimated to be about 2 to 2.5 meters long, roughly the size of a goat.
estimates.quote: Its length is estimated to have been about 2 to 2.5 m, comparable to the size of a goat.

estimates.statement: Stegoceras was a small bipedal dinosaur measuring approximately 2 to 2.5 meters in length and weighing between 10 and 40 kilograms.
estimates.quote: Stegoceras era un pequeño dinosaurio bípedo de aproximadamente 2 a 2,5m de largo y pesaba alrededor de 10 a 40kg.

estimates.statement: Its estimated length was approximately 2 to 2.5 meters, comparable to the size of a goat.
estimates.quote: Se estima que su longitud fue de aproximadamente 2 a 2,5m, comparable al tamaño de una cabra

estimates.statement: Stegosaurus ungulatus was the largest species in the genus, measuring between 7 and 9 meters in length and weighing approximately 6.9 tonnes.
estimates.quote: At 7-9 m in length and 6.9 tonnes (7.6 short tons) in weight, it was the largest species within the genus Stegosaurus.

estimates.statement: Some large Stegosaurus individuals may have reached lengths of 7.5 to 9 meters and masses of 5.0 to 5.3 metric tons.
estimates.quote: Some large individuals may have reached 7.5-9 m in length and 5.0 - 5.3 MT in body mass.

estimates.statement: Stegosaurus ungulatus is one of the largest stegosaurians, with specimens reaching about 9 meters in length and weighing over 6.9 metric tons.
estimates.quote: One species, Stegosaurus ungulatus, is one of the largest known of all the stegosaurians, with the largest known specimens measuring about 9 m long and weighing over 6.9 MT.

estimates.statement: Large Stegosaurus individuals could grow up to 9 meters long, 4 meters high, and weigh between 5.3 and 7 tons.
estimates.quote: Aunque los individuos grandes, YPM Coll, podían crecer hasta 9 metros de largo y de 4 metros de alto y entre 5,3 y 7 toneladas de masa corporal

estimates.statement: S. stenops measured 6.5 meters in length and 3.5 metric tons in mass, while S. ungulatus reached 7 meters in length and 3.8 metric tons in mass.
estimates.quote: S. stenops reached 6.5 m in length and 3.5 MT in body mass, while S. ungulatus reached 7 m in length and 3.8 MT in body mass.

estimates.statement: Stegosaurus stenops was shorter than other species in the genus, reaching a length of 6.5 meters.
estimates.quote: It was shorter than other species, at 6.5 m.

estimates.statement: In 2016, Gregory S. Paul estimated S. stenops to be 6.5 meters long and 3.5 metric tons.
estimates.quote: En 2016, Gregory S. Paul presentó una estimación más baja de 6,5 metros de longitud y 3,5 toneladas métricas de masa corporal para S. stenops

estimates.statement: Stenonychosaurus was a small dinosaur reaching up to 2.5 meters in length and 35 kilograms in body mass.
estimates.quote: Stenonychosaurus was a small dinosaur, up to 2.5 m in length and 35 kg in body mass.

estimates.statement: Stenonychosaurus was a small dinosaur standing 0.9 meters tall and measuring between 2.4 and 3.5 meters in length.
estimates.quote: Stenonychosaurus era un dinosaurio pequeño, medía 0,9m de altura, entre 2,4 a 3,5 de longitud, y pesaba desde 35 a 50kg.

estimates.statement: S. quadriscissus and S. triscissus reached a maximum length of about 3.5 meters.
estimates.quote: Stenopterygius was a medium-sized ichthyosaur, with S. quadriscissus and S. triscissus reaching a maximum length of about 3.5 m

estimates.statement: The species S. uniter is known from the holotype SMNS 14216, a complete articulated skeleton of an adult measuring about 3.35 meters long, which was destroyed in World War II.
estimates.quote: S. uniter es conocido del holotipo SMNS 14216, un esqueleto articulado completo que fue destruido en la Segunda Guerra Mundial. El animal era un adulto de cerca de 3.35 metros de largo.

estimates.statement: The species S. uniter could exceed 4 meters in length.
estimates.quote: while the larger S. uniter could exceed 4 m

estimates.statement: The maximum total length of Stenopterygius was 4 meters.
estimates.quote: Su longitud total máxima era de 4 metros.

estimates.statement: Young adult S. triscissus reached at least 2 meters in length, with the type specimen measuring 2.2 meters.
estimates.quote: Young adults reached at least 2 m long, as indicated by the type specimen of S. triscissus measuring 2.2 m long

estimates.statement: S. altonensis reached a length of about 1.5 meters, while S. productus reached 3 meters.
estimates.quote: S. altonensis had length about 1.5 m, while S. productus reached 3 m.

estimates.statement: Stethacanthus measured 70 centimeters in length and 25 centimeters in height.
estimates.quote: Stethacanthus medía 70 centímetros de longitud y 25 de alto

estimates.statement: Struthiomimus altus was estimated to be about 4.3 meters long, 1.4 meters tall at the hips, and weigh around 150 kg.
estimates.quote: The size of S. altus is estimated as about 4.3 m long and 1.4 m tall at the hips, with a weight of around 150 kg.

estimates.statement: An adult Struthiomimus reached about 4.3 meters in length, 1.4 meters in height at the hips, and weighed around 150 kg.
estimates.quote: Un Struthiomimus adulto alcanzaba cerca de 4,3m de largo y 1,4 de alto hasta la cadera, pesando alrededor de 150kg

estimates.statement: Struthiomimus was over 3 meters long but weighed little due to its hollow bones and light skeleton.
estimates.quote: Struthiomimus medía más de 3m, sin embargo no pesaba mucho debido a sus huesos huecos y a la ligereza general de su esqueleto

estimates.statement: Styracosaurus was relatively large, reaching 5.5 meters in length, 1.8 meters in height, and weighing 2.4 tons.
estimates.quote: Eran relativamente grandes, tenían 5,5 metros de longitud, 1,8 de altura y pesaban 2,4 toneladas.

estimates.statement: Adult Styracosaurus measured approximately 5.5 meters in length and weighed about 2.7 tons.
estimates.quote: Los individuos adultos del género Styracosaurus midieron aproximadamente 5,5 metros de largo cuando y pesaban de las 2,7 toneladas.

estimates.statement: Styracosaurus albertensis measured approximately 5.5 to 5.8 meters in length and stood about 1.65 meters high at the hips.
estimates.quote: These fossils indicate that S. albertensis was around 5.5-5.8 m in length and stood about 1.65 m high at the hips.

estimates.statement: This dinosaur grew to lengths between 5 and 5.5 meters and weighed approximately 1.8 to 2.7 metric tons.
estimates.quote: Styracosaurus was a relatively large dinosaur, reaching lengths of 5 - 5.5 m and weighing about 1.8 - 2.7 MT.

estimates.statement: Adult Styracosaurus measured between 5 and 5.5 meters in length and weighed between 1.8 and 2.7 metric tons.
estimates.quote: Individuals of the genus Styracosaurus were approximately 5 - 5.5 m long as adults and weighed about 1.8 - 2.7 MT.

estimates.statement: Gregory S. Paul estimated the length of Suchomimus to be 9.5 meters and its weight to be 2.5 tonnes in 2010.
estimates.quote: Gregory S. Paul, sin embargo, dio estimaciones más bajas de 9,5 metros y 2,5 toneladas en 2010.

estimates.statement: The type specimen of Suchomimus was estimated to be between 10.3 and 11 meters long and weigh between 2.7 and 5.2 tonnes.
estimates.quote: La longitud del espécimen tipo de Suchomimus, un subadulto, se estimó inicialmente entre 10,3 a 11 metros, con un peso estimado de entre 2,7 y 5,2 toneladas.

estimates.statement: Historical estimates suggest Suchomimus was 9.5 to 11 meters long and weighed between 2.5 and 3.8 metric tons.
estimates.quote: The size of Suchomimus was historically estimated at 9.5 – 11 m in length, with a weight of 2.5 - 3.8 MT.

estimates.statement: Michael Benton agreed that the BYU 9024 vertebra belongs to Supersaurus, suggesting the animal could reach 50 meters in length.
estimates.quote: Michael Benton also agreed with the reclassification, giving the Supersaurus BYU 9024 specimen an approximate length of up to an impressive 50 m

estimates.statement: Fossil evidence estimates Supersaurus to have been 32 to 34 meters long and weighed between 35 and 40 tonnes.
estimates.quote: Las evidencias fósiles han dado a estimar a esta especie de saurópodo con una longitud de 32 a 34 metros y un peso de entre 35 y 40 toneladas.

estimates.statement: Originally, Supersaurus and Brachiosaurus bones were thought to represent a single dinosaur measuring 25 to 30 meters long, 8 meters high at the shoulder, 15 meters in total height, and weighing around 70 tons.
estimates.quote: Originalmente, estos huesos de Supersaurus y Brachiosaurus se pensaron que representaban a un solo dinosaurio que medía entre 25 a 30 metros de largo, 8 alto al hombro, 15 metros de altura total, y que quizás hubiera pesado alrededor de 70 toneladas.

estimates.statement: Suzhousaurus was an unusually large therizinosauroid reaching lengths of 6 meters and weighing nearly 3.1 tonnes.
estimates.quote: Suzhousaurus was an unusually large Early Cretaceous therizinosauroid reaching lengths of 6 m and nearly 3.1 t in weight.

estimates.statement: Suzhousaurus was an unusually large Early Cretaceous therizinosauroid reaching a length of 6 meters and a weight of nearly 3.1 tonnes.
estimates.quote: Suzhousaurus era un terizinosauroide del Cretácico Inferior inusualmente grande que alcanzaba una longitud de 6 metros y casi 3,1 toneladas de peso.

estimates.statement: Talarurus could grow up to 5 to 6 meters long and weigh between 454 and 907 kilograms.
estimates.quote: that could grow up to 5-6 m long and weighed about 454 to 907 kg

estimates.statement: Estimates for Talarurus vary, with lengths of 5-6 meters and weights ranging from 454 kg to 2 tons.
estimates.quote: Thomas Holtz and Gregory S. Paul estimated its length at 5-6 m, Paul gave a weight of 2 t, however, Holtz estimated it around 454 to 907 kg

estimates.statement: Talarurus was a medium-sized, heavy quadruped that grew up to 5 meters long and weighed between 454 and 907 kilograms.
estimates.quote: Era un herbívoro cuadrúpedo de tamaño mediano, corpulento, que vivía en el suelo , que podía crecer hasta 5 metros de largo y pesaba alrededor de 454 a 907 kilogramos, entre media y una tonelada.

estimates.statement: Taniwhasaurus was a medium-sized mosasaur with a maximum estimated length of around 6.7 meters.
estimates.quote: Taniwhasaurus is a medium-sized mosasaurid, with maximum size estimates putting it at around 6.7 m in length.

estimates.statement: The largest known specimen of T. oweni (SMU NMNZ R1532) has a skull length of 86.9 cm and an estimated total body length of 6.72 meters.
estimates.quote: The largest known specimen of T. oweni is the partial skull specimen SMU NMNZ R1532, which was estimated to have measured 86.9 cm long, resulting in a total body length estimate of 6.72 m.

estimates.statement: T. oweni is estimated to have been at least 6 meters long based on the fossil remains.
estimates.quote: Conocido a partir de un individuo que mediría al menos 6 metros de largo, basándose en estimaciones de los restos hallados.

estimates.statement: The largest Tarbosaurus specimens measured between 10 and 12 meters in length and weighed up to 4.5 to 5 metric tons.
estimates.quote: Like most known tyrannosaurids, Tarbosaurus was a large bipedal predator, with the largest specimens measuring 10-12 m and weighing up to 4.5 - 5 MT.

estimates.statement: Although smaller than Tyrannosaurus, Tarbosaurus was one of the largest tyrannosaurids, with fully developed individuals reaching 10 to 12 meters in length, 3 meters in hip height, and weighing up to 4.3 to 4.5 tons.
estimates.quote: Aunque más pequeño que Tyrannosaurus, Tarbosaurus era uno de los tiranosáuridos más grandes, con el individuo completamente desarrollado más grande que medía aproximadamente entre 10 a 12 metros de largo, 3 de altura de la cadera y pesaba hasta 4,3 a 4,5 toneladas en masa corporal

estimates.statement: Tarbosaurus measured approximately 10 meters in length, 3 meters in hip height, and weighed up to 4.5 metric tons.
estimates.quote: Medía aproximadamente 10 metros de largo, 3 de altura de la cadera y pesaba hasta 4,5 toneladas métricas de masa corporal.

estimates.statement: O'Keefe and Street estimated a total length of around 2 meters in 2009.
estimates.quote: O'Keefe and Street later estimated a smaller total length of around 2 m in 2009

estimates.statement: Teleocrater was a carnivorous quadruped measuring 7 to 10 feet in length with unusually long neck vertebrae.
estimates.quote: A carnivorous quadruped measuring 7 - 10 ft long, Teleocrater is notable for its unusually long neck vertebrae.

estimates.statement: A possible specimen of T. trigonodon found in January 2021 in Rutland Water is estimated to be slightly over 10 meters long.
estimates.quote: The 'Rutland Sea Dragon', a possible specimen of T. trigonodon discovered in January 2021 in the Rutland Water, near Oakham, is estimated to be slightly over 10 m long.

estimates.statement: Temnodontosaurus is generally estimated to be 9 meters long, making it one of the largest known ichthyosaurs.
estimates.quote: Generally estimated at 9 m long, Temnodontosaurus is one of the largest known ichthyosaurs, although not as imposing as some Triassic forms.

estimates.statement: Specimens of T. platyodon, T. trigonodon, and T. crassimanus are estimated to reach around 9 meters in length.
estimates.quote: Based on different specimens, the species T. platyodon, T. trigonodon and T. crassimanus have body sizes estimated to be around 9 m in length.

estimates.statement: Temnodontosaurus species were large animals, reaching up to 12 meters in length, with great muscular strength and were skilled coastal predators.
estimates.quote: Las especies de Temnodontosaurus eran animales grandes, alcanzando algunas hasta 12 metros de longitud, de gran fuerza muscular y hábiles depredadores costeros.

estimates.statement: Based on a nearly complete skeleton of T. trigonodon, McGowan estimated the size of von Huene's Banz specimen at 16 meters long.
estimates.quote: Based on SMNS 50000, a nearly complete skeleton of T. trigonodon, the author estimated the size of Banz's specimen at 16 m long, as Huene initially suggested.

estimates.statement: Gregory S. Paul estimated that T. dossi was 7 meters long and weighed 1000 kg.
estimates.quote: Paul also estimated that T. dossi would have been 7 m long and weighed 1000 kg.

estimates.statement: Tenontosaurus measured between 6.5 and 8 meters in length, stood 2.2 meters tall, and weighed between 1 and 2 tons.
estimates.quote: Los tenontosaurios median entre 6,5 y 8 metros de longitud, 2,2 de altura y pesaba de 1 a 2 toneladas.

estimates.statement: Gregory S. Paul estimated the maximum adult size of Teratophoneus to be 8 meters long and 2.5 metric tons.
estimates.quote: In 2016, Gregory S. Paul gave an estimation of 8 m long and 2.5 MT for the maximum adult size.

estimates.statement: The Teratophoneus specimen was not fully developed and was estimated by Carr et al. to be about 6 meters long and 667 kg.
estimates.quote: El espécimen de Teratophoneus no estaba completamente desarrollado,y de acuerdo con la estimación de Carr et al. medía cerca de 6 metros de largo y 667 kilogramos de peso.

estimates.statement: Terrestrisuchus was an extinct genus of very small early crocodylomorphs measuring about 76 cm in length.
estimates.quote: Terrestrisuchus is an extinct genus of very small early crocodylomorph that was about 76 cm long.

estimates.statement: The total estimated body length is 4.5 meters, though some argue this figure is an overestimate.
estimates.quote: The length of the tail including the unpreserved portion was later estimated to be 2.5 m, resulting in a total estimated body length of 4.5 m for the animal, though it's been argued this is an overestimate.

estimates.statement: The total estimated body length of Tethyshadros is 4.5 meters, though some argue this is an overestimation.
estimates.quote: Posteriormente, se estimó que la longitud de la cola, incluida la parte no preservada, era de 2,5 m, lo que resultó en una longitud corporal total estimada de 4,5 m para el animal, aunque se ha argumentado que esto es una sobreestimación.

estimates.statement: The total length of Thalattoarchon is estimated to be at least 8.6 meters.
estimates.quote: La longitud total de Thalattoarchon se estima en al menos unos 8,6 metros.

estimates.statement: A 2023 book by Darren Naish revised the estimated length of Thalattoarchon to 9 meters.
estimates.quote: In a 2023 book, Darren Naish slightly increased the estimated length of the animal, bringing it to 9 m.

estimates.statement: Thalattoarchon is a large ichthyosaur estimated to measure more than 8 meters in length.
estimates.quote: Thalattoarchon es un ictiosaurio de gran tamaño que mediría más de 8 metros de largo.

estimates.statement: The original describing team estimated Thalattoarchon to be over 8.6 meters long, making it a particularly large ichthyosaur.
estimates.quote: The describing team estimated the size of Thalattoarchon at over 8.6 m long, making it a particularly large ichthyosaur.

estimates.statement: Therizinosaurus could reach lengths of 9 to 10 meters, heights of 4 to 5 meters, and weigh over 5 tons.
estimates.quote: could grow up to 9 - 10 m long and 4 - 5 m tall, and weigh possibly over 5 t

estimates.statement: Therizinosaurus reached an estimated length of 9 to 10 meters, which is enormous for a maniraptoran dinosaur.
estimates.quote: By maniraptoran standards, Therizinosaurus attained enormous sizes, estimated to have reached 9 to 10 m in length.

estimates.statement: Therizinosaurus was a large therizinosaurid that could grow up to 10 meters long, 5 meters high, and possibly weigh 5 tons.
estimates.quote: Therizinosaurus era un tericinosáurido de gran tamaño que podía crecer hasta 10 metros de largo y 5 de alto, y pesar posiblemente 5 toneladas.

estimates.statement: Adult Thescelosaurus measured roughly 3 to 4 meters in length and weighed between 200 and 300 kilograms.
estimates.quote: Adult Thescelosaurus would have measured roughly 3-4 m long and probably weighed 200 to 300 kg.

estimates.statement: The largest known Thescelosaurus species, T. garbanii, was estimated to be 4 to 4.5 meters long and weigh between 200 and 300 kilograms.
estimates.quote: The largest known thescelosaurid, its body length has been estimated at 2.5 – 4.0 m and the weight at 200 – 300 kg, with the large type specimen of T. garbanii estimated at 4 – 4.5 m long.
